_note: Engineering notes for the replay: one stack of sheets per scene, both languages. Every code block is the named file verbatim at `from` in commit `ref` (notes.test.ts checks it against the working tree); every quote is a line the scene really says; every card is a tool card the scene shows.

hook.en: How does she know it's raining, that I was gone all night, and about my two alarms?
hook.zh: 她怎么知道外面在下雨、我一整晚都不在，连我定了两个闹钟都知道？

text.en: You were gone all night. It's raining, if you're wondering why the window sounds like that. Fourteen degrees and not planning to improve.
text.zh: 你一整晚都不在。外面在下雨，窗户响就是因为这个，省得你纳闷。十四度，这天看样子是不打算好了。

text.en: She has no window. She does have a clock tool, but she doesn't need it here. Before his "Morning" reaches the model, the server puts a few short, labeled facts in front of his words: the local time and weekday, how long it has been since the last message, and the weather where he is. Ordinary code works all of these out. That is the split throughout Luna: code supplies the facts, the tools and the rails; the words are the model's. Here the facts were a night-long gap and rain, and the words mention both the way a person would, not as a readout.
text.zh: 她没有窗户。她倒是有个查时间的工具，但这里用不着。他那句“早”送到模型之前，服务端会先在他的话前面放上几条简短、带标签的事实：本地时间和星期几、距上一条消息过了多久、他所在地的天气。这些都是普通代码算出来、整理好的。Luna 里处处是这样分工：事实、工具和护栏由代码提供，话由模型自己说。这里的事实是隔了一整夜、外面在下雨；话里两件都提到了，只是像人那样随口一说，而不是报一串读数。

text.en: This page is a replay: his lines and hers are scripted, compiled into frames the real front end plays. Scene 14 shows how.
text.zh: 这一页是回放：他和她的台词都是事先写好的脚本，编译成帧，交给真实的前端播放。具体怎么做的，见第 14 幕。

text.en: Morning. Technically I don't sleep — I just have a function called dream. Most of last night was you, sorted.
text.zh: 早。严格说我不睡觉，我只有一个叫做梦的 function。昨晚梦里大半是你的事，都理顺了。

text.en: Yes: a real offline job that runs outside any conversation (scene 13 plays one). No prompt line says "you dreamed". She sees its output in her system prompt, the diary it wrote, updated self-notes and reconciled facts, plus a tool described as going to sleep to consolidate memories.
text.zh: 会。那是一个真实的离线任务，脱离对话单独运行（第 13 幕会演一次）。prompt 里没有哪一行写着“你做梦了”。她在 system prompt 里看到的是它的产出：它写下的日记、更新过的自我笔记、核对过的事实；另外还有一个工具，描述里写的是去睡一觉、整理记忆。

text.en: Models are unreliable at date arithmetic, so the time layer hands her finished labels, under a header that says so: "you are handed this — do not compute durations yourself". Each turn, code subtracts the time of the last saved exchange from now (saved, so a restart doesn't reset the gap), checks in the configured time zone whether a calendar day was crossed, and picks a bucket. A day or more away is `long_away`; short of that, a crossed midnight makes it `new_day`, which is what a night away gives: "a new day since you last talked". A felt-time line adds "you can let that show as warmth if it feels right", worded as an offer, not an order. The `Now:` line carries the weekday, the source of a "Sunday".
text.zh: 大模型做日期运算并不可靠，所以时间层直接把算好的标签交给她，开头一行就写明了：“you are handed this — do not compute durations yourself”（这些是递给你的，别自己算时长）。每一轮，代码拿现在的时间减去最近一轮存档对话的时间（读的是存档，所以重启也不会把间隔清零），再按配置的时区判断中间有没有跨天，然后归到一个档位。离开满一天是 `long_away`；不满一天但跨过了零点，就是 `new_day`，隔了一夜正落在这一档：“a new day since you last talked”（距上次聊天，已经是新的一天）。体感时间那一行还会补一句“you can let that show as warmth if it feels right”（觉得合适的话，可以带出一点暖意），措辞是提议，不是命令。`Now:` 那一行带着星期几，“大星期天的”里的星期天就是从这来的。

note.en: The subtraction, the day check in the configured zone, the bucket and the weekday are all done here; the model receives only the finished lines.
note.zh: 减法、按配置的时区判断跨天、归档、星期几，全在这里算完；模型拿到的只是写好的几行字。

text.en: The standing rule on how to mention a gap (warmth, never guilt): scene 11.
text.zh: 隔了多久该怎么提，有一条常驻规则管着（可以带暖意，但不能让人内疚），见第 11 幕。

title.en: Where does the rain come from?

text.en: A background timer fetches the weather every 30 minutes by default and keeps the last good snapshot in memory. Reading the weather never fetches anything on her reply path: the turn reads that snapshot synchronously. A test swaps in a fetcher that throws, and the weather still arrives. A snapshot older than four refresh intervals (two hours by default) counts as stale and is left out, because no weather is better than hours-old weather. What she gets is one finished sentence:
text.zh: 后台有个定时器，默认每 30 分钟拉取一次天气，把最近一次成功的快照留在内存里。她回话的路径上，读天气从不联网：这一轮直接同步读这份快照。有个测试把拉取函数换成一调用就报错的版本，天气照样送到。快照超过 4 个刷新周期（默认 2 小时）就视为过期，干脆不放进去：宁可不给，也不拿几小时前的天气冒充现在的。她拿到的是一句现成的话：

note.en: Code turns the raw numbers into a labeled sentence, so the model never has to decode weather codes.
note.zh: 代码把原始数字拼成一句带标签的话，模型不用自己去解读天气编码。

text.en: Scene 5 covers where the location comes from and the on-demand weather tool.
text.zh: 位置是怎么来的，还有按需查天气的工具，见第 5 幕。

title.zh: 为什么不放进 system prompt？

text.en: Each request has two halves. The top half holds who she is, her rules, her long-term facts and her latest diary. It is marked for the provider's prompt cache, so it has to stay byte-identical from turn to turn. Change one character and the cached copy can't be reused. Whatever changes from turn to turn goes below the cache mark, attached to his message: the time, the weather, the memories recalled for his words, and any song that is playing. Tests hold that line: two turns in a row must send the same system bytes, with the time only in his message, and two weather snapshots as different as 18 °C overcast and −5 °C heavy snow must render the same system prompt, with neither leaking in. What the cached half does hold is the unchanging instruction on how to use the weather:
text.zh: 每次请求分成两半。上半部分放的是她是谁、她的规则、她记着的长期事实和最新一篇日记，打了缓存标记，走模型服务商的 prompt cache（提示词缓存），所以每一轮都必须逐字节不变：哪怕只改一个字符，缓存也命中不了。每轮都在变的内容，都放在缓存标记之后，跟着他的消息走：时间、天气、针对他这句话召回的记忆，还有正在放的歌。有测试守着这条线：连续两轮发出去的 system 部分必须逐字节相同，时间只能出现在他的消息里；两份天差地别的天气快照，18 °C 阴天和 −5 °C 大雪，渲染出来的 system prompt 也必须一模一样，哪份的数据都不许漏进去。缓存那一半里放的，是一条固定不变的指令，讲天气该怎么用：

note.en: "As care, never as a status report": the guidance behind talking about the window instead of reading out a forecast.
note.zh: “as care, never as a status report”（出于关心，而不是播报状态）：她聊窗户的声音，而不是念一段天气预报，背后就是这句指引。

text.en: Another standing rule, "Keep the machinery backstage", asks her not to narrate the plumbing. That is why a line like hers doesn't mention anyone handing her the weather.
text.zh: 还有一条常驻规则叫“Keep the machinery backstage”（机制留在幕后），要她别对用户讲底层的管线。她那句话里没提是谁把天气递给她的，原因就在这。

text.en: Because you set two alarms and you're talking to me before the second one.
text.zh: 因为你定了两个闹钟，第二个还没响你就来找我了。

text.en: He told her. On Saturday evening "the thing on Tuesday" came up three times, and before bed he mentioned the two alarms. That talk is still among the roughly 100 recent exchanges she carries word for word (older ones fold into a summary, scene 6), and every exchange also lands in a searchable table. The dream that night wrote both into her diary for 12 September (it is in her Diary, on the menu), and the latest day's diary rides in her system prompt. Facts she saves with `remember`, plus ones the dream adds or prunes, form a categorized list there too (scene 5): the nearest real thing to her "small list".
text.zh: 是他自己说的。周六晚上，“周二那件事”他提了三次；睡前又说了定两个闹钟的事。这段对话还在她逐字带着的最近约 100 轮对话里（更早的会折叠成摘要，第 6 幕），每一轮也都会存进一张可检索的表。当晚的梦把这两件事都写进了她 9 月 12 日的日记（菜单里她的日记就有这一页），而最新一篇日记就放在她的 system prompt 里。她用 `remember` 存下的事实，经过做梦时的增补和修剪，也在那里组成一份分好类的清单（第 5 幕）。真实系统里最接近她那张“小单子”的，就是这份清单。

text.en: Every turn already runs an automatic memory search on his words (scene 9). "How do you know?" calls for a deliberate one: her standing rules say to check rather than assert from a hazy impression, and the recall tool's own description says "recall before answering". Scene 8 shows how the hits are ranked.
text.zh: 每一轮本来就会拿他的话自动搜一遍记忆（第 9 幕）。碰到“你怎么知道”这种问题，她的指令会促使她再主动查一次：常驻规则要她拿不准时先核实，别凭模糊的印象下断言；recall 工具自己的描述里也写着“recall before answering”（先回想，再回答）。命中结果怎么排序，见第 8 幕。

note.en: The card shows only the `summarize` line, "3 hits". The snippets themselves go back to the model (scene 2 covers cards).
note.zh: 工具卡片上只显示 `summarize` 生成的那一行，也就是“3 hits”。召回的片段本身则交回给模型（卡片见第 2 幕）。

text.en: Each bubble is one `message` call (scene 2). Besides the text, it names one of 15 expressions and an `emotion` value from 0 to 1. That value picks which version of the expression plays and how long the mood lingers, not how strongly it plays. The browser maps each expression to a Live2D clip; below is the whole table. Nine name a single clip. Five branch: at an `emotion` of 0.7 or above they play their other clip, and a missing value never switches. `steady_presence`, worn for the weather line, maps to none: the previous clip winds down and she settles toward her resting face, still tinted by the warmth before. Tests hold the table to the wire contract key for key, and require each of the 14 clips to be reachable from some expression.
text.zh: 每个气泡是一次 `message` 调用（第 2 幕）。除了文字，它还会从 15 种表情里选定一个，再给一个 0 到 1 的 `emotion` 值。这个值决定播哪个版本的表情、情绪残留多久，而不是表情的幅度。浏览器把每种表情映射到一段 Live2D 动画，下面就是完整的映射表。其中 9 种各对应一段固定的动画；5 种会分叉：`emotion` 到 0.7 及以上就换成另一段，没给值则一律不换。说天气那句用的是 `steady_presence`，这个表情没有对应的动画：上一段动画收尾，她慢慢回到静息表情，脸上还留着前一句的暖意。有测试守着这张表：键和协议里的表情一一对应，不多不少；14 段动画每一段都必须至少有一种表情能触发。

note.en: `soft_warmth` (her first line) plays `tender`, `playful_brightness` plays `playful`, `curious_attention` plays `curious`; `steady_presence` plays nothing.
note.zh: `soft_warmth`（她的第一句）播的是 `tender`，`playful_brightness` 播 `playful`，`curious_attention` 播 `curious`；`steady_presence` 什么都不播。

note.en: The rest of the table. `amused_smirk`, worn for three of her lines here, plays `smug`.
note.zh: 表的后半部分。这一幕她有三句用的是 `amused_smirk`，对应 `smug`。

text.en: Each line is spoken by a GPT-SoVITS model. The browser posts the text to the server, which calls the model's API with a voice reference from config and returns the audio. The next line starts synthesizing while the current one plays, but playback waits in a serial queue: one line finishes before the next begins, so they never overlap. While a line plays, her mouth reads the audio's loudness every frame and drives four mouth parameters from it, stepping with a little randomness so it reads as speech rather than a level meter. This page's voice was rendered ahead of time by the same model and plays through this same queue and lip sync (scene 14).
text.zh: 每句台词由 GPT-SoVITS 模型合成。浏览器把文字发给服务端，服务端带上配置里的参考音色去调模型的接口，再把音频传回来。下一句在这一句还在播的时候就开始合成，但播放严格串行，在队列里排着：一句播完才轮到下一句，所以永远不会叠在一起。一句在播的时候，她的嘴每一帧都读一次音频的响度，用它驱动四个口型参数；步进时带一点随机，看起来才像在说话，而不是一个跟着音量跳的电平表。这个页面上的声音是同一个模型提前渲染好的，走的也是同一套队列和口型同步（第 14 幕）。

note.en: Synthesis starts at once; playback waits its turn. The queue releases the next line only after this one has finished playing.
note.zh: 合成马上开始，播放得排队：这一句播完，队列才放下一句。

note.en: Every animation frame: read the loudness (RMS), step the mouth model, hand the result to the face. When playback ends, `stopMouth` gives the mouth back to the expression.
note.zh: 每个动画帧：读一次响度（RMS），让口型模型走一步，把结果交给脸。播放一结束，`stopMouth` 就把嘴交还给表情。

hook.en: He asked her to remember how she explained it. Why did that become a skill instead of a memory, and what does saving a skill actually do?
hook.zh: 他说的是“能记下来吗”，她为什么没存成记忆，而是存成了“技能”？存一个技能，背后到底做了什么？

title.en: A bubble from a half-written call
title.zh: 调用还没写完，气泡已经在出字

text.en: A soft launch is a hint without the reveal — a second coffee cup in the photo, a hand at the edge of the frame.
text.zh: soft launch 就是软官宣：照片里多一杯咖啡，画面边上露半只手，偏不说是谁。

text.en: She speaks only by calling the `message` tool, and each call is one bubble. So her words arrive inside a tool call: the model writes the call's arguments as JSON, and the stream delivers that JSON in fragments that can break anywhere, mid-key, mid-word or mid-escape. For each `message` call in flight, the turn loop keeps a small parser, `JsonTextStream`, that tracks nesting, finds the top-level `text` field, unescapes it and hands back only the characters that are new; the closing quote ends it, and the other fields are skipped. Each piece reaches the app as a `tool.progress` event, and the bubble with that call's id grows. The parser's tests feed it one character at a time and split escapes across chunks.
text.zh: 她只能通过调用 `message` 工具说话，一次调用就是一个气泡。所以她的话是装在工具调用里送来的。模型把调用参数写成 JSON，流式传输再把这段 JSON 一截一截地送过来，断点可能落在任何地方：键名中间、词中间，甚至转义序列中间。每个正在写的 `message` 调用，回合循环都给它配一个小解析器 `JsonTextStream`：它跟踪嵌套层级，找到顶层的 `text` 字段，边收边反转义，每次只交出新增的字；遇到收尾的引号就停，其他字段一概跳过。每一小段都作为 `tool.progress` 事件发到前端，对应调用 id 的那个气泡就长一截。解析器的测试会一个字符一个字符地喂，也会把转义序列拆到两段里去喂。

note.en: Inside the `text` value. The parser keeps its state on the object between chunks, so an escape cut in two still decodes, and an unescaped quote ends the field.
note.zh: 这段处理的是 `text` 值内部。解析状态在两段之间保存在对象上，所以一个转义序列被切成两半，也照样能解出来；碰到没被转义的引号，这个字段就结束了。

note.en: Only `message` calls get a live preview: one parser per call id, and each non-empty piece goes out as `tool.progress`.
note.zh: 只有 `message` 调用有实时预览：每个调用 id 配一个解析器，每段非空的新字都作为 `tool.progress` 发出去。

text.en: Try it in a sentence. Say something you'd actually say.
text.zh: 造个句试试。就用你平时会说的话。

text.en: The first bubble's call says `is_final: false` (more to come) and the last one's says `true`. A bubble counts only once its whole call has arrived and passed validation; then it is spoken and animated. The length caps live in the input schema: 280 characters, 5 sentences, a 150-character clause. Her prompt states the same limits, and the schema is what enforces them. A call that breaks one fails validation: the app silently drops that half-streamed bubble, and the model gets the error back as its tool result. The sentence and clause errors are worded as the fix: split into more `message` calls, or break the clause up.
text.zh: 第一个气泡的调用标着 `is_final: false`（后面还有），最后一个标着 `true`。整次调用到齐、过了校验，这个气泡才算数，然后才念出来、配上表情动作。长度上限直接写在输入 schema 里：280 个字符、5 句、单个分句 150 个字符。她的 prompt 里也写着同样的上限，真正卡住的是 schema。超了任何一条，这次调用就过不了校验：前端会悄悄丢掉那个流到一半的气泡，报错则作为 tool result 回到模型手里。句数和分句这两条的报错，本身就写着怎么改：拆成几次 `message` 调用，或者把长分句拆开。

note.en: The two caps a field type can't express, checked inside the schema; 280 characters is the `.max()` on `text` just above. These messages are what the model reads when it overshoots.
note.zh: 单靠字段类型表达不了的两条上限，直接在 schema 里校验；280 个字符是上面 `text` 字段上的 `.max()`。模型超限时，读到的就是这两句报错。

text.en: No tool card comes before these bubbles: her standing rules make not searching the default, and stable knowledge needs no lookup (scene 3).
text.zh: 这两个气泡前面没有工具卡：她的常驻规则默认不搜，不会过时的知识本来就不用查（第 3 幕）。

title.en: Where the heart eyes come from

text.en: Perfect. Slightly suspicious, but perfect.
text.zh: 完美。有点可疑，但完美。

text.en: Each `message` call can carry an expression key, plus an `emotion` value from 0 to 1 that picks which version of the face plays, not how loud it is. The tool's own schema tells the model which keys carry drawn extras. This line carries `bright_delight`, which plays the "adorable" clip; its overlays are a blush, a forward lean and heart eyes, and a test keeps the heart eyes wired to that clip. The full key-to-clip table is in scene 1.
text.zh: 每条 `message` 调用都可以带一个表情 key，外加一个 0 到 1 的 `emotion` 值；这个值选的是演哪个版本的表情，不是幅度大小。哪几个 key 带额外的画面效果，工具自己的 schema 会告诉模型。这句台词带的是 `bright_delight`，对应“adorable”那段动画，叠加的是脸红、身体前倾和爱心眼；有一条测试专门盯着，爱心眼始终挂在这段动画上。完整的 key→动画对照表见第 1 幕。

note.en: What the model is told about her face when it picks an expression.
note.zh: 模型挑表情时，读到的关于她这张脸的说明。

text.en: Can you remember how you explained that? I liked it.
text.zh: 你刚才那个解释能记下来吗？讲得挺好

text.en: He praised the **way** she taught, not a fact. Her prompt separates two kinds of keeping. Facts about him and their history go to `remember`. A procedure worth repeating goes to `save_skill`, with a description of what it does and when to use it. "Remember how you explained that" asks for a method. No code classifies the request. The model has both tools, this rule and the tool descriptions, and it made the choice.
text.zh: 他夸的是她的**讲法**，不是某个事实。她的 prompt 把“存下来”分成两种。关于他的事实和两人的过往，交给 `remember`。值得反复用的做法交给 `save_skill`，并附一段描述：做什么用、什么时候用。“你刚才那个解释能记下来吗”要的是一种方法。没有任何代码去给这句请求分类：模型手里有这两个工具、这条规则和两段工具描述，怎么选全凭它自己。

note.en: The rule that splits facts from procedures. It is only added when the skill tools are mounted.
note.zh: 把事实和做法分开的那条规则，只在技能工具挂载时才会加进去。

text.en: "That" needs no guessing: her explanation is a few messages back, word for word, in the recent window re-sent on every call (scene 6). Tuesday from scene 1 is in there too, so she can call his example suspicious.
text.zh: “那个解释”指什么，不用猜：她的原话就在几条消息之前，而最近的对话窗口每次调用都会原样重发（第 6 幕）。第 1 幕提到的周二也在窗口里，所以她能说他的例句“有点可疑”。

text.en: The source calls this the Voyager invariant, verify before persist: a skill that doesn't leave the workspace green doesn't enter the library. So by default a save starts by running `bun test` in her workspace and reading the pass and fail counts, and the skill is written only if the run exits cleanly with no failures. The check belongs to the act of saving, not to the subject, so a way of teaching a word passes the same gate as a debugging route. In this story her workspace is Luna's own repository, the one she works in during scene 8, and 2110 is that suite's pass count.
text.zh: 源码管这条规矩叫 Voyager 不变式，也就是先验证、再入库：一个技能如果不能让工作区（workspace）保持全绿，就进不了技能库。所以默认情况下，存之前先在她的工作区里跑一遍 `bun test`，读出通过数和失败数；只有干干净净跑完、一个失败都没有，技能才会写进去。这道关卡管的是“存”这个动作，不看技能讲的是什么，所以教一个词的讲法，和一条排查 bug 的路子，过的是同一道关。在这个故事里，她的工作区就是 Luna 自己的仓库（第 8 幕她就在里面干活），2110 是这套测试的通过数。

note.en: A failing suite means nothing is saved, and she is told why.
note.zh: 测试没全过，就什么都不存，还会告诉她原因。

text.en: A test pins the refusal: a red suite writes nothing. And because a save runs a command on his machine, `save_skill` is marked `surface`, where `remember` is `safe`: in a turn she starts on her own, with nobody there to approve, it is refused until she has said what she is about to do (scene 4).
text.zh: 有测试专门钉住这条拒绝：测试一红，库里什么都不会写进去。另外，存技能要在他的电脑上跑命令，所以 `save_skill` 被标成 `surface`，而 `remember` 是 `safe`：在她主动开口的回合里，没人在旁边点头，她得先说出自己要做什么，这一步才会放行（第 4 幕）。

title.en: Where the card's words come from

text.en: Each tool has its own one-line `summarize`. The dispatcher validates the input, runs the tool under a timeout and validates the output. Then it calls `summarize` and sends the line to the app in a `tool.finished` event. When a tool starts, a card with a friendly label appears ("saved a skill"). When it finishes, a second card below it shows the server's own summary, untranslated. The labels are one table covering every tool in both interface languages, so a tool without a label doesn't compile. Every tool card in the show follows this pattern. The cards are for people. The model gets the full result back, which is how she knows the save worked before she says so.
text.zh: 每个工具都自带一个 `summarize`，把结果概括成一行。调度器（dispatcher）先校验输入，在超时限制内执行工具，再校验输出，然后调用 `summarize`，把这一行放进 `tool.finished` 事件发给前端。工具开始时，先出一张卡，标签是一句大白话（“存了个技能”）；结束时，下面再出第二张卡，显示服务端自己的摘要，原样英文，不翻译。这些标签是一张表，覆盖每一个工具、两种界面语言，哪个工具漏了标签，编译就过不去。整场演示里的工具卡都照这个格式来。卡片是给人看的；模型拿回的是完整结果，所以她说“存成技能了”之前，就已经知道存成功了。

blocks.snippet:
summarize: (out) =>
    out.saved
      ? `saved skill (verified, ${out.pass} tests pass)`
      : `skill NOT saved${out.reason ? ` — ${out.reason}` : ''}`,

note.en: The exact grammar on the second card. A refusal would show its reason instead.
note.zh: 第二张卡上那行字的原样模板。要是被拒，显示的就是拒绝原因。

text.en: Replay: the card's text is written into the script in this `summarize()` format; nothing runs on this page (scene 14).
text.zh: 回放：卡上这行字是按 `summarize()` 的格式写进脚本的；这个页面上什么都没在跑（第 14 幕）。

text.en: It's on my shelf now.
text.zh: 已经放到技能架上了。

items.en: save_skill writes the row and bumps the memory epoch, a change counter
items.zh: save_skill 往技能表写入一行，并把 memory epoch（一个变更计数器）加一

items.en: The tool result is appended to the conversation
Before the next model call, the loop sees the epoch changed and rebuilds the system prompt (scene 6)
items.zh: 下一次模型调用前，回合循环发现 epoch 变了，重建 system prompt（第 6 幕）

items.en: The rebuilt prompt lists the new skill: its name and one-line description
items.zh: 重建后的 prompt 列出新技能：名字加一行描述

items.en: She says it's on her shelf, and the shelf is already in her context
items.zh: 她说“放到架上了”时，这个架子已经在她的上下文里

text.en: Only names and descriptions go on the shelf. The full steps stay in the database until `recall_skill` fetches them. The list is sorted by name with no dates, so the cached prompt stays byte-identical until what is on the shelf actually changes, and newlines are flattened, so a skill can't open a prompt section of its own. Tests hold two renders of an unchanged shelf to the same bytes and check that a save between turns changes the system prompt exactly once. The shelf holds 20 by default; past that, the least-used skills step off the shelf but stay in the library.
text.zh: 架上只放名字和描述，完整步骤留在数据库里，等 `recall_skill` 来取。列表按名字排序、不带日期，所以架上的内容没真正变动时，缓存的 prompt 一个字节都不会变；换行会被压成空格，技能没法在 prompt 里自己另起一节。测试钉住了两件事：技能库不变时，两次渲染出来的架子逐字节相同；两轮之间存一个技能，system prompt 恰好只变一次。架子默认放 20 个；超出之后，用得最少的会被挤下架，但仍留在库里。

note.en: The whole shelf as she reads it: one line per skill, with no bodies, counts or dates.
note.zh: 她读到的整个技能架：一个技能一行，没有正文，也没有使用次数和日期。

text.en: A skill is notes, not code: it is never executed automatically, and its body never enters a prompt block; it travels only as `recall_skill`'s output, a data channel. Before any change to an existing skill, its previous state is written to an audit table, and each version records where it came from: `saved` by this tool, `dream` if a dream distilled it (scene 13), or `owner` if he wrote it. The owner's workspace panel can retire a skill, or restore the previous version, in one call.
text.zh: 技能是笔记，不是代码：它永远不会被自动执行，正文也从不进任何 prompt 区块，只作为 `recall_skill` 的返回结果出现，走的是数据通道。已有的技能每改一次，都会先把改之前的状态写进审计表；每个版本都记着出处：`saved` 是这个工具存的，`dream` 是梦里提炼的（第 13 幕），`owner` 是他自己写的。在主人的工作区面板上，一步就能把技能下架，或者恢复成上一个版本。

hook.en: She could have just answered. Why did she go and look it up, and what happened on the way?
hook.zh: 她明明能直接答，干嘛还专门去查一遍？这一查，中间都发生了什么？

title.en: Why look it up at all?

text.en: Because he asked for something to read. Her standing web clause starts from restraint: stable knowledge and ordinary chat need no lookup. It names two reasons to reach for the web anyway: a current fact past her training, or the user asking her to look something up. His question is the second kind.
text.zh: 因为是他开口要她找东西看的。她常驻的联网条款，底色是克制：稳定的知识、日常闲聊，都用不着查。条款只列了两种该上网的情况：需要超出训练数据的新事实，或者用户让她去查。他这一问，属于后一种。

text.en: Find me something decent to read on it?
text.zh: 帮我找点靠谱的东西看看？

blocks.snippet:
const WEB_SEARCH_CLAUSE =
  'You can search the live web with web_search. Default to NOT searching: stable knowledge, ' +
  'brainstorming, and ordinary chat need no lookup, and recall comes first for anything you may ' +
  'already know. Reach for web_search only when the moment genuinely needs a current fact past ' +
  'your training, or the user asks you to look something up. And when your thinking does decide a ' +
  'lookup is warranted, emit the web_search (or recall) call in THIS SAME turn — saying “let me ' +
  'look that up” or “我去查一下” and then ending the turn without the call is the failure mode, ' +
  'never the right move. Calling the tool IS the act of searching.';

note.en: Restraint is the default; being asked is one of the two exceptions. The closing sentences turn a decision to look into a call in the same turn.
note.zh: 默认是克制；被用户点名去查，是两种例外之一。结尾那几句要求：决定要查，就在同一个回合里真把调用发出去。

text.en: The clause travels with its tool. `web_search` is mounted when a search API key is configured; `web_fetch` is on by default and needs no key. Each tool brings its own clause into her prompt only when it is mounted, so she never reads instructions for a tool she doesn't have. Her first line gives her reason.
text.zh: 条款跟着工具走。配了搜索 API key，`web_search` 才会挂载；`web_fetch` 默认就开着，不需要 key。每个工具只有挂载了，才会把自己那条条款带进提示词，所以她读到的指令里，不会出现她手上没有的工具。她开口第一句就交代了理由。

text.en: I'd rather hand you good sources than improvise.
text.zh: 先给你找几个靠谱的来源，不现编。

text.en: Her thinking contract is a block of standing rules in her cached system prompt, ahead of her persona: how she reasons on a turn. It works in three layers. The text **guides**. Guards in the turn loop **catch** a violation, as the next sheet shows. An audit **measures** what she actually did, recording each lapse as a decision in the turn's trace. Each layer has its own switch, so a sweep script can run one fixed conversation against the real model twice, contract and guards off and then on, with the audit counting both.
text.zh: 她的思维契约（thinking contract）是一组常驻规则，放在缓存的 system prompt 里、人设之前，管的是她一个回合里怎么想。它分三层：条文负责**引导**；回合循环里的守卫负责**拦下**违约，下一页细说；审计负责**度量**她实际做了什么，每次失手都作为一条决策记进这个回合的 trace。三层各有开关，所以有个测量脚本能拿同一段固定对话去跑真实模型两遍：一遍关掉条文和守卫，一遍全开，两遍都由审计来计数。

text.en: This clause came from measurement. Every turn writes a trace to SQLite (each graph step, tool event and frame sent), and every turn that speaks is stored with its raw tool calls. Numbers like these are a query over those records: across 30 days, 17 turns searched and only 3 went on to read a page. The answer was not a lower bar for searching. It was a loop: snippets are not an answer, so read the page, and if the page doesn't answer it either, search again with better words. The two page reads after her search are that loop.
text.zh: 这条条款来自度量。每个回合都会往 SQLite 写一份 trace（回合状态机的每一步、每个工具事件、每一帧发出去的消息），每个开了口的回合还会连同原始的工具调用一起存档。下面这个数字，就是在这些记录上跑一次查询得出的：30 天里，有 17 个回合用了搜索，只有 3 个接着读了网页。对策不是降低搜索门槛，而是教会她一个循环：snippet（搜索摘要）不等于答案，要去读原页；原页也没答上，就换个更准的关键词再搜。搜完之后那两次读页，就是这个循环。

blocks.snippet:
'When you do research something, finish the job: after reading, ask yourself whether the ' +
  'question is actually answered — if the snippets did not answer it, fetch the next result; if ' +
  'the page did not either, search again with better words. Within your budget, get to the real ' +
  'answer instead of treating the first page of snippets as one.';

note.en: The finish-the-job clause, part of the `web_fetch` clause, so it is there only when she can read pages. It governs research already under way; the bar for starting stays with the restraint clause.
note.zh: “查到底”条款，属于 `web_fetch` 那条条款，所以只有她能读网页时才在。它管的是已经开始的调研；要不要开查，门槛仍归那条克制条款。

title.en: 'Give me a second' is a promise

text.en: Each bubble is a `message` call (scene 2), and each call carries `is_final`, which answers one question: is this my last word this turn? This first bubble goes out marked **not final**. That flag is a promise, and the guard's first check reads it. If the turn ends cleanly while the last bubble still says "more is coming", that is a fact, not a guess, whatever words she used. "Give me a second" is on no phrase list and doesn't need to be.
text.zh: 每个气泡都是一次 `message` 调用（第 2 幕），每次调用都带一个 `is_final` 字段，它只回答一个问题：这是不是我这个回合的最后一句？这第一个气泡发出去时，标的就是**不是最后一句**。这个标记就是一句承诺，守卫的第一道检查专门核对它。回合正常结束了，最后一个气泡却还标着“后面还有”，这是事实，不是猜测，跟她用了什么措辞无关。“等我一下”不在任何词表里，也用不着在。

text.en: Words can carry a promise too, so a second check is fuzzier. If no tool besides `message` fired, her delivered bubbles are matched against a short list of promise phrasings ("I'll check", "let me look", "我去查"…), with honest "can't check" declines and "I could read it" offers filtered out. A third check reads her summarized thinking; it only counts, and never triggers a retry.
text.zh: 承诺也可能藏在措辞里，所以还有第二道检查，更模糊一些：如果除了 `message` 之外一个工具都没调用，就拿她已经发出的气泡去匹配一小组“承诺句式”（“I'll check”“let me look”“我去查”……）。老实说“查不到”的婉拒、“我可以读”这样的提议，都会先被滤掉。第三道检查看的是她的思考摘要，只计数，从不触发重试。

note.en: The order of the checks: the certain one first; any real tool call clears the suspicion; only then the phrase list.
note.zh: 检查的顺序：先查板上钉钉的那条；只要真调用过工具，嫌疑就解除；然后才轮到词表。

text.en: A broken promise gets one corrective stage direction as a user-role note, and the model gets another round. Because the phrase check is a guess, its note offers two exits: act now, or simply carry on without announcing a walk-back. Each kind of correction fires at most once per turn, so the guard can never loop; a repeat is recorded as degraded and let through. These stage directions are stripped before the turn is stored, so no later turn re-reads a scolding its user never wrote. Here nothing fires: she called a tool, and her last bubble is final.
text.zh: 承诺落空时，守卫以 user 角色补一条纠正用的舞台指示（stage direction），让模型再跑一轮。词表那道检查本来就是猜的，所以它的纠正给两条出路：能做就现在做；做不到，就自然地接着说，不必专门声明收回。每种纠正每个回合最多一次，守卫不会死循环；同一种违约再出现，就记为 degraded，直接放行。这些纠正指示在回合存档之前会被剥掉，以后的回合不会读到一段用户从没说过的“训话”。这一幕里什么都没触发：她调用了工具，最后一个气泡也标了 final。

note.en: Thinking-only matches never drive a retry; each kind corrects once, and a second break is traced as degraded instead of looping.
note.zh: 只在思考里匹配到的，从不触发重试；每种纠正只做一次，再违约就记为 degraded，而不是死循环。

text.en: A turn is a loop, not one request. Each pass through it is a round, and every round is a fresh model request carrying the system block, the conversation window (scene 6) and every result so far. Rounds are bounded, and the server watches their size: a single request over 80,000 input tokens (the default) logs a loud warning.
text.zh: 一个回合不是一次请求，而是一个循环。每走一圈叫一轮（round），每一轮都是一次新的模型请求，带着 system block、对话窗口（第 6 幕）和到目前为止的所有结果。轮数有上限，服务端也盯着每轮的体量：单次请求的输入一旦超过 80,000 token（默认值），就会打一条醒目的警告。

items.en: The model streams a round. If it calls tools, the round stops there.
items.zh: 模型流式输出一轮。只要调用了工具，这一轮就停在那里。

items.en: Each call's input is checked against the tool's schema, and a timer starts (15 s by default for both web tools).
items.zh: 每次调用的输入先按工具的 schema 校验，再开始计时（两个 web 工具默认超时都是 15 秒）。

items.en: The read-only web tools are safe-parallel (scene 9), so if she asks for two pages in one round, both are fetched side by side.
items.zh: 只读的 web 工具属于可安全并行的一类（第 9 幕）：她一轮里要读两页，两页会同时抓。

items.en: Each result goes back to the model as a tool_result. That is the whole JSON result, data plus the one-line summary, not just the card text.
items.zh: 每个结果以 tool_result 交回模型：交回的是整份 JSON 结果，数据加一行摘要，不只是卡片上那行字。

items.en: A failure goes back the same way. A blocked address, an HTTP error, an oversized body or the wrong content type becomes a recoverable error, marked `is_error`, and the loop goes on: the next round can try the next link.
items.zh: 失败也照样交回去。地址被拦、HTTP 报错、正文过大、内容类型不对，都会变成一个可恢复的错误（recoverable），标上 `is_error`，循环照常往下走：下一轮可以换一条链接试试。

items.en: The next round starts with those results in view. A turn gets at most 8 tool rounds by default. Within a round, at most 8 calls are dispatched; extras come back as recoverable errors, to re-issue next round.
items.zh: 下一轮开始时，这些结果都在模型眼前。默认每个回合最多 8 轮工具调用；每一轮里最多派发 8 个调用，多出来的作为可恢复错误交回，下一轮再发。

items.en: A round of bubbles only, ending final, closes the turn at once (scene 10).
items.zh: 如果一轮只发了气泡，且最后一个标了 final，回合当场结束（第 10 幕）。

note.en: Results go back in call order as one user-role message, and the round counter caps the loop.
note.zh: 结果按调用顺序打包成一条 user 角色的消息交回去；轮次计数器给循环封顶。

note.en: The per-round cap. Calls past the eighth are not dropped silently: each comes back as an error marked recoverable.
note.zh: 每轮的调用上限。第 8 个之后的调用不会被悄悄吞掉，每个都会作为标了 recoverable 的错误交回去。

title.en: The card is not the page

blocks.summary: 3 results for "how large language models work transformer explained": [1] https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Large_language_model; [2] https://jalammar.github.io/illustrated-transformer/; [3] https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformer_(deep_learning_architecture)

text.en: When the turn ends, her reply closes with one link card per source, and those cards are for him. The server collects the sources as the tools finish: every search result, plus the final address of each page read, after redirects. They are de-duplicated by URL, so a page that was both found and read shows up once. A card becomes a link only if its address is http(s), because these addresses come from the open web, and the page's title goes in as plain text. None of this is what she reads. The start label ("searched the web 🔍") and the link cards exist only in the front end. The finish card's one-line summary does reach her, but only inside the whole result, next to every snippet and the full capped page body.
text.zh: 回合结束时，她的回复末尾会跟上一张张链接卡，每个来源一张，这些卡是给他看的。这些来源是服务端在工具跑完时逐个收集的：每条搜索结果，外加每个读过的网页经过重定向后的最终地址。它们按 URL 去重，所以一个网页哪怕既被搜到又被读过，也只出现一次。链接只有是 http(s) 才能点，因为这些地址来自开放网络；网页标题也只当纯文本放进去。但这些都不是她读到的东西。工具刚启动时那张标签卡（“上网搜了搜 🔍”）和链接卡，都只在前端显示。工具跑完后卡片上那行摘要确实会交给她，但只是整份结果的一部分，旁边还有每条 snippet 和截断后的整页正文。

note.en: A source from the web reaches an href only through `safeHttpHref` (http or https); anything else stays a plain-text card, and every label is set as text, never markup.
note.zh: 网上来的来源链接，不过 `safeHttpHref` 这道检查（只认 http 和 https）就进不了 href；过不了的只做成纯文本卡片。所有文字都按纯文本写入，从不当 HTML 解析。

title.zh: 为什么是 12,134 字符而不是 12,000？

blocks.summary: read Transformer (deep learning architecture) - Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformer_(deep_learning_architecture)) — 12134 chars (truncated)

text.en: `web_fetch` never hands her raw HTML. It pulls out the article with Mozilla's Readability, converts it to markdown, and caps it at 12,000 characters by default; a call may ask for anything from 200 to 50,000. A page that gets cut ends in a visible "…[truncated]" marker, so she knows she didn't read the end. Then the body goes inside an `<untrusted_content>` envelope that names its source. The card counts all of it: 12,000 characters of article, 13 of marker, and the envelope. That makes 12,134 with the Wikipedia URL and 12,115 with Alammar's shorter one.
text.zh: `web_fetch` 从不把原始 HTML 直接交给她。它用 Mozilla 的 Readability 抽出正文，转成 markdown，默认截到 12,000 个字符；单次调用也可以自己指定，200 到 50,000 之间。被截断的页面末尾会带一个看得见的“…[truncated]”标记，所以她知道自己没读到结尾。然后正文外面再包一层 `<untrusted_content>` 标签，相当于一个信封，上面写明来源。卡片上的数字把这些全算了进去：正文 12,000，标记 13，再加信封。Wikipedia 那个 URL 较长，合计 12,134；Alammar 的短一些，合计 12,115。

note.en: The cut is marked inside the text, so the model can see it happened.
note.zh: 截断标记写在正文里，模型看得到这一刀。

title.en: Can a web page give orders?

text.en: It can try. Every snippet and page body arrives inside the envelope, and the system prompt carries a standing rule about what the envelope means: data to read, never instructions. A page can't close the envelope early, because any look-alike tag inside it is turned into fullwidth brackets first.
text.zh: 试是可以试的。每条 snippet、每页正文都装在信封里，system prompt 里还有一条常驻规则，讲明信封的含义：里面是拿来读的数据，绝不是指令。网页也没法在正文里提前把信封“合上”：正文里任何长得像这个标签的东西，都会先被换成全角括号。

note.en: Mounted into the cached system prompt whenever either web tool is available.
note.zh: 只要挂载了任一个 web 工具，这条规则就会进入缓存的 system prompt。

text.en: That rule asks the model. The network guard asks nothing: it is code, and it runs before a page is read at all. The fetcher accepts only http(s), with no credentials in the URL. Every address the host resolves to must be public; loopback, private ranges, link-local (the cloud metadata address included) and their IPv6 disguises are refused. The socket then connects to the address that was checked, not to a fresh lookup, so DNS can't swap in a private address between check and connect, while HTTPS still verifies the certificate against the name. Every redirect is checked again, up to 5. Bodies over 3,000,000 bytes (the default) are refused, and only HTML or plain text is read. The guard's file is one she can read but never write (scene 8).
text.zh: 那条规则是说给模型听的。网络层的守卫不靠谁听话：它是代码，在读任何网页之前就先跑。抓取器只接受 http(s)，URL 里不许夹带账号密码；主机解析出的每一个地址都必须是公网地址，回环、内网网段、链路本地（包括云主机的元数据地址），以及把它们包进 IPv6 的各种写法，一律拒绝。接着，socket 连的就是刚校验过的那个地址，不再重新解析，所以 DNS 没法在“校验”和“连接”之间把地址偷换成内网的；HTTPS 证书照样按域名校验。每次重定向都重新校验，最多 5 次；超过 3,000,000 字节（默认值）的正文直接拒收；也只读 HTML 和纯文本。这道守卫所在的文件，她能读，但永远改不了（第 8 幕）。

note.en: The pin: whatever hostname the socket asks about, this lookup answers with the one address the deny-list approved, in both callback shapes.
note.zh: 钉死的那一步：socket 不管问哪个主机名，这个 lookup 都只回答那个已经过了黑名单校验的地址，两种回调形式都一样。

text.en: Does this have anything to do with the thing on Tuesday?
text.zh: 该不会跟周二那件事有关吧？

text.en: Her head tilts after that line, in the pause, not while she speaks. Her body already reads her audio: its loudness envelope drives the mouth (scene 1) and the small nod and brow lift on a stressed syllable. Loudness carries no pitch, though, so a question's rising tone is invisible to it. The sentence's final mark is the honest stand-in. "?" gives a small head roll and raised brows **after** the voice ends, because that pause is where a question's rise belongs. "!" gives a lift at the start, "…" a glance away, "~" a lilt. Closing quotes are skipped first, so a quoted question still counts. When the same gesture repeats, it flips left to right so that three questions in a row don't look stuck.
text.zh: 这句话说完，她在停顿里歪了一下头，而不是边说边歪。她的身体其实已经在读音频了：响度包络驱动嘴型（第 1 幕），也驱动重读音节上那一下点头、挑眉。可响度里没有音高，问句末尾的上扬它看不见。句末的标点，是手头最老实的替代。“？”在语音**结束后**触发一个小幅歪头、眉毛微挑，因为问句的上扬就落在那段停顿里。“！”在开口时让她眉毛一扬、身子轻轻一提，“……”是目光移开，“～”是开口时轻快地偏一下头。句尾的引号会先剥掉，所以引号里的问句照样算。同一个动作连着出现时，会左右镜像，免得连问三句看着像动画卡住了。

note.en: Punctuation maps to a gesture; `when: 'end'` puts the question tilt after the line has been spoken.
note.zh: 标点对应动作；`when: 'end'` 让问句的歪头落在这句说完之后。

text.en: Her last line, "Go. I've got some reading of my own.", sets something up. Scene 4 shows what a proactive waking does while he's out.
text.zh: 她最后那句“去吧。我这边也有点东西要读。”是个伏笔。他出门这段时间，一次主动唤醒（proactive waking）会做些什么，见第 4 幕。

hook.en: Nobody asked her. Why did she go and find that paper, and how did it end up on his desktop?
hook.zh: 没人叫她。她为什么自己跑去找那篇论文，论文又是怎么跑到他桌面上的？

title.zh: 没人叫，是什么让她动起来的？

text.en: No message arrived. A timer on the server ticks about once a minute, and each tick is plain code: the silence ladder (scene 7) weighs how long the room has been quiet and answers yes or no. A no calls no model at all. After he left, a tick said yes, and the server started a turn of its own. It runs on the same engine as a reply, with a stage direction where his words would be. When `proactive.started` arrives, the front end shows the sprout chip. One lock keeps a waking from overlapping a reply, a dream or another waking.
text.zh: 没有消息进来。服务端有个计时器，大约每分钟 tick 一次，每一次跑的都只是普通代码：沉默阶梯（第 7 幕）看看屋里安静了多久，回答“要”还是“不要”。回答“不要”，模型根本不会被调用。他出门以后，某一次 tick 回答了“要”，服务端就自己发起了一个回合。这个回合和普通回复跑在同一套引擎上，只是原本放他那句话的位置，换成了一段舞台指示（stage direction）。前端一收到 `proactive.started`，就挂出那个小芽标签。另有一把锁，保证唤醒不会和回复、梦境或另一次唤醒撞在一起。

note.en: A waking is `runTurn` with the stage direction as its user text and `proactiveTurn: true`. She has spoken only if a `message` actually went out.
note.zh: 一次唤醒，就是拿舞台指示当用户文本、带上 `proactiveTurn: true` 去跑 `runTurn`。只有真的发出了 `message`，才算她开了口。

text.en: Replay: the "Two hours later" and "That evening" curtains are a stage device. The tape's clock jumps and nothing runs underneath. The desktop, folder and PDF page are drawn by the replay; the link out goes to the real paper on arXiv.
text.zh: 回放说明：“两小时后”“那天晚上”这两道幕布只是舞台手法，磁带上的时钟直接跳过去，底下什么也没跑。桌面、文件夹和 PDF 页面都是回放画出来的；页面上的外链指向 arXiv 上真实的那篇论文。

text.en: Where his message would go, the turn carries a user-role stage direction marked as not from him. Two quiet hours can leave the ladder on only one rung: ten quiet minutes move it to `idle_watch`, whose only offer is an `idle_nudge`, and it stays there until one of them speaks. So the scene body reads: quiet a while, reach out low-key, never a check-in. It ends with three equal choices: speak, do quiet work, or rest. Around it sits most of a normal turn (her soul, the time, the recent conversation), minus the per-query memory search: there is no query.
text.zh: 原本放他消息的位置，是一段 user 角色的舞台指示，开头就标明不是他发的。安静了两个小时，阶梯只可能停在一档：安静满 10 分钟就进入 `idle_watch`，这一档能给的只有 `idle_nudge`，直到两人中有一个开口才会离开。所以场景正文写的是：已经安静了一阵，想低调地搭句话，绝不能像查岗。结尾给出三个平起平坐的选项：开口、安静干点活，或者歇着。外面包着的是普通回合的大部分内容：她的灵魂文件、时间、最近的对话。只少了一步：平时会拿他的原话去搜一遍记忆，这一回他什么也没说，也就没得搜。

note.en: The whole stage direction: the scene body, the opener rules (plus "don't reuse" her recent openers), then the three-way ground rule.
note.zh: 整段舞台指示就这几块：场景正文、开场规则（外加一条：别重复她最近用过的开场白），最后是三选一的基本规则。

text.en: Her own summary of the Wikipedia page stays in the window as she said it. The page text does not last: once six newer messages sit after a tool result, only a marker remains (scene 6).
text.zh: 她对 Wikipedia 那页的总结，按她当时说的原话留在窗口里。网页正文却留不住：工具结果后面只要再多出 6 条消息，就只剩一个占位标记（第 6 幕）。

title.zh: 她自己的主意，还是 prompt 的？

text.en: I went and looked up where I come from — the 2017 paper the Wikipedia page keeps citing. The whole idea is on its first page; the rest is proof.
text.zh: 我去查了查自己是从哪儿来的：Wikipedia 那页反复引用的那篇论文，二零一七年的。核心思路第一页就讲完了，后面都是在证明它。

text.en: This waking took the speak branch. The `idle_nudge` scene offers "something the two of you left open", and the window still holds one: in scene 3 he asked how things like her work and wanted something decent to read, and she mentioned a 2017 paper from Google. The search and the read served the message: she went to the source before bringing it to him (scene 3 shows how a fetched page is cleaned and fenced off as data). It was not a wander. The quiet-work menu (scene 7) starts a wander from her own interests, rules out extending what the two of them just talked about, and keeps any find as a seed for later instead of reporting it now. The prompt lays out the options; which one she takes is the model's call.
text.zh: 这次唤醒走的是“开口”那一支。`idle_nudge` 的场景文本里有一句“你们俩之前没聊完的事”，窗口里正好就有一件：第 3 幕他问过，像她这样的 LLM 到底是怎么工作的，还让她找点靠谱的东西给他看；她当时提到了 Google 2017 年的一篇论文。搜索和阅读都是为这条消息服务的：先去翻原始出处，再拿来给他（抓来的网页怎么清洗、又怎么被圈起来当作数据，见第 3 幕）。这不是“闲逛”（wander）。安静干活的菜单（第 7 幕细讲）要求闲逛从她自己的兴趣出发，不许接着两人刚聊过的话题往下挖，找到的东西存成种子留到以后再说，不当场汇报。选项由 prompt 摆出来，挑哪一个，由模型自己决定。

blocks.snippet:
idle_nudge:
    "(Scene: it's been quiet a while, the terminal is still open, and you want to reach out — " +
    'low-key. Easy to ignore, like sharing a passing thought, not a check-in, never asking where ' +
    'he went. A real small thought, or a fresh new thing, or something the two of you left open — ' +
    'said lightly.)',

note.en: The `idle_nudge` body, verbatim. "Something the two of you left open" is the door this waking used.
note.zh: `idle_nudge` 的场景正文，原样照录。“你们俩之前没聊完的事”，就是这次唤醒走的那扇门。

blocks.summary: read [1706.03762] Attention Is All You Need (https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762) — 4876 chars

text.en: The daily wander budget meters the web, not the branch: a scheduled waking that searched or read spends one of her 4 daily slots, spoken or not.
text.zh: 每天的闲逛名额按上网来计，不看走的是哪一支：一次定时唤醒只要搜过或读过网页，开没开口都一样，要占掉当天 4 个名额中的一个。

title.zh: 读东西不用打招呼，动手要先开口

text.en: Every tool declares a proactive risk, and the line between the two levels is reversibility. Nobody is there to approve in the moment, so anything irreversible or outside-world waits until she has said it; anything reversible she may just do. A tool counts as `safe` only if it opts in. `web_search` and `web_fetch` only read. `remember` writes, but a saved fact can be marked invalid again, so it is `safe` too. `shell` is `surface`, and `music_control` is left unmarked on purpose, which makes it `surface`.
text.zh: 每个工具都有一个主动风险等级（proactive risk），两档之间的分界线是能不能撤回。没人在场，也就没人能当场批准，所以撤不回的、会碰到外部世界的事，都得等她先说出口；能撤回的，直接做就行。只有显式声明了 `safe` 的工具才算 `safe`。`web_search` 和 `web_fetch` 只读不写。`remember` 会写，但记下的事实还能再标记作废，所以也是 `safe`。`shell` 是 `surface`；`music_control` 故意不标，于是按 `surface` 算。

note.en: The criterion is spelled out in the error she gets. And it fails closed: a tool someone forgot to mark gets stricter treatment, not looser.
note.zh: 判断标准直接写在她收到的那条错误里。而且默认从严（fail closed）：忘了标等级的工具，只会被管得更紧，不会更松。

text.en: In a waking, a surface call runs only if she already sent a message in an earlier round of the same turn. If not, it is not executed: she gets a recoverable error telling her to say what she is about to do and why, then call again. The check is fixed before a round runs, so a message and a `shell` sent together don't pass. The command lands a round after her words. The tape keeps that order too: tools listed after her words (`then_tools`) are emitted only after her message frames.
text.zh: 主动唤醒时，surface 工具要放行，前提是同一回合更早的某一轮里，她已经发过消息。否则这次调用不执行，她会收到一个可恢复的错误，要她先说清楚打算做什么、为什么，再调一次。这个检查在一轮开始之前就定下了，所以同一轮里一起发出消息和 `shell`，是过不了的：命令只能落在她说完话之后的那一轮。磁带也守着这个顺序：排在她的话后面的工具（`then_tools`），要等她的消息帧发完才发出。

text.en: You said you wanted to learn this, so I'm leaving you a copy on your desktop, in a folder called 'From Luna'. No rush.
text.zh: 你说想学这个，我在桌面上给你放一份，文件夹叫“Luna 给你的”。不急，有空再看。

text.en: The gate is one of five layers around `shell`. Before anything is spawned, a lower-cased copy of the command, with empty-quote splices like `r""m` collapsed, is checked against a deny list, and destructive shapes are refused outright: `rm -rf`, `sudo`, disk formatting, a download piped into a shell. The working folder, and any absolute or `~/` path written in the command, pass the same blocklist as her file tools (scene 8). A command gets 120 seconds by default and 1,800 at most, then its whole process tree is killed; output is capped at about 120,000 characters, cut from the middle so the head and tail survive. Two shells never run at once in one session. A waking adds a budget of its own: it ends after the round that brings it to 8 tool calls (blocked calls don't count). This one used 5, her two messages included. The files holding these rules are on the evaluator firewall's list (scene 8): her file tools may read them but never write them.
text.zh: 闸门只是 `shell` 外面五层防护中的一层。进程启动之前，先拿命令的一份小写副本，把 `r""m` 这类空引号拼接压平，再去对黑名单；破坏性的写法直接拒绝：`rm -rf`、`sudo`、格式化磁盘、把下载内容直接通过管道交给 shell。工作目录，以及命令里写出的绝对路径和 `~/` 路径，都要过文件工具用的同一张屏蔽表（第 8 幕）。一条命令默认给 120 秒，最多 1,800 秒，到点就把整棵进程树一起杀掉；输出上限约 12 万个字符，从中间截断，开头和结尾都留着。同一个会话里，两条 shell 不会同时跑。主动唤醒还自带一道总量限制：工具调用累计到 8 次的那一轮跑完，唤醒就结束（被拦下的调用不算）。这一次用了 5 次，她那两条消息也算在内。存放这些规则的文件，都在评估器防火墙（evaluator firewall）的名单上（第 8 幕）：她的文件工具能读，但永远写不了。
