note.en: The top of the deny list. It runs before anything is spawned; a hit is refused by name, as a recoverable error, so she can choose a safer command.
note.zh: 黑名单的开头几条。它在任何进程启动之前就跑；命中了就按规则名拒绝，返回的是可恢复的错误，她可以换一条更安全的命令。

text.en: This scene is the exact shape the web rules watch for: a page read, then a command. Her web clause asks her to say what she is about to do before any hard-to-undo action a page leads her to. In a waking, the gate makes that mandatory for every surface tool. And in any turn that both reads the web and fires a surface tool, a `web_to_action` decision goes into the trace: the pattern is measured first, and the data decides whether it ever needs a harder rule. Ask, enforce, record: the same shape as her thinking contract (scene 3).
text.zh: 这一幕正好是网页规则专门盯着的模式：先读网页，再跑命令。她的网页条款要求：网页要是引着她去做难以撤回的事，得先说出来。在主动唤醒里，闸门把这一条变成了硬规定，对所有 surface 工具一视同仁。而在任何回合里，只要既读了网页、又调了 surface 工具，trace 里就会记下一条 `web_to_action` 决策：先把这种模式量出来，要不要再加更硬的规矩，由数据决定。提要求、强制执行、留记录，和她的思维契约（第 3 幕）是同一个结构。

text.en: The card says only "shell exit 0" because the tool's summary is just the exit code, by design. The command itself travels in the call's `tool.started` event, and the trace keeps it.
text.zh: 卡片上只有“shell exit 0”，因为这个工具的摘要按设计就只报退出码。命令本身随调用的 `tool.started` 事件一起发出，trace 里也留着。

title.en: How does she know which paper?

text.en: Her waking is in the record. A waking that speaks is saved like any other turn. The only difference is that its user text is stored empty, so no message from him appears that he never sent; the stage direction stays in the raw record the window is rebuilt from (scene 12). That evening, "the paper you left me" arrives in a window that already holds her folder message. His reply also resets the ladder: the next time it decides, it starts again from `engaged`, with the escalation back at zero (scene 7).
text.zh: 那次唤醒留了档。开了口的唤醒和普通回合一样存下来，唯一的区别是用户那一栏存成空的，所以对话里不会冒出一条他没说过的话；舞台指示则留在原始记录里，窗口重建时照样用得上（第 12 幕）。到了晚上，他那句“你留的那篇论文”发过来时，窗口里已经有她说把论文放进文件夹的那条消息。他这一回话，沉默阶梯也跟着复位：下一次做判断时，它从 `engaged` 重新起步，之前一级级的加码清零（第 7 幕）。

text.en: And whatever tomorrow's thing is — sleep. Dentists hate a tired patient.
text.zh: 还有，不管明天是什么事，今晚早点睡。牙医最烦没睡醒的病人。

text.en: Both halves of that line are already in her context: the time block (scene 1) says it is Monday, and the window still holds scene 3, where "the thing on Tuesday" and her dentist joke both come up.
text.zh: 这句话的两半，她手里本来就有：时间块（第 1 幕）写着今天星期一；窗口里还留着第 3 幕，“周二那件事”和她那个看牙的玩笑都在里面。

hook.en: Why does a weather card appear only the second time?
hook.zh: 为什么第二次才出天气卡片？

title.zh: 第一次是递来的，第二次是查来的

text.en: It's raining. Fourteen degrees, and it's not going to get much better — I've been watching the sky so you don't have to.
text.zh: 外面在下雨。十四度，不会好到哪去。天我一直替你盯着，你就不用盯了。

text.en: No card under that line, because she called nothing. Whenever a fresh reading exists, every message he sends reaches the model with a one-line weather reading attached, read from a snapshot that a background timer keeps up to date (scene 1). Attaching it is a read from memory: no network on her reply path, no extra round with the model. So something like "light rain, 14°C" was already in front of the model when he said "grim".
text.zh: 这句下面没有工具卡，因为她什么也没调用。只要缓存里的天气读数还没过期，他发的每条消息送进模型时都会附上一行天气，这一行是从后台定时器维护的快照里读出来的（缓存怎么维护，见第 1 幕）。附上这一行只是读一下内存：她回话的路上不联网，也不用多跑一轮模型。所以他说“阴得要命”的时候，类似 “light rain, 14°C” 的信息早已摆在模型面前。

text.en: Do I need an umbrella for the six o'clock thing?
text.zh: 六点那个事要带伞吗

text.en: Now a plan rides on the answer, and that is exactly when the `weather` tool's own description says a fetch is worth it: when he asks, or when a concrete plan makes it relevant, never just to recite a forecast. Whether to fetch was the model's call. A fetch costs what the attached line doesn't: a live request to a weather service, then one more round with the model, because the result has to go back to it before she can answer. So the line gives her what the description calls "a passing sense of the weather", and a fetch waits for a question or a plan.
text.zh: 这回有个具体安排要看天气来定，而这正是工具自带的 description 写明值得去查的时候：用户问起时，或者天气会影响到某个具体安排时；不要只为了复述预报去查。查不查，是模型自己的决定。查一次，要付出那行天气不用付的成本：先实时请求一次天气服务，再多跑一轮模型，因为结果得先交回模型，她才能开口。所以随消息附上的那一行只管让她对天气心里有数；真去查，要等他问起，或者有安排要定。

text.en: The first path runs on every turn while his message is assembled; the second runs only when the model calls the tool.
text.zh: 第一条路在每个回合拼装他的消息时都会走；第二条只在模型调用工具时才走。

note.en: No `await`: `getSnapshot()` only reads memory, so a reply never waits on a weather service. A cold or stale cache leaves the block out; a formatting error skips the block, never the turn.
note.zh: 这里没有 `await`：`getSnapshot()` 只读内存，回话从不等天气服务。缓存还没热或已过期，这一块就不放；拼句子出了错，也只跳过这一块，不耽误这一轮。

blocks.snippet:
export const weatherTool = defineTool({
  name: 'weather',
  description:
    'Get the current weather for the configured location: temperature, condition, and today’s ' +
    'high / low and chance of rain. Use it when the user asks, or when a concrete plan makes it ' +
    'relevant — a passing sense of the weather is already in your context, so do not fetch just to ' +
    'recite a forecast.',
  input: Input,
  output: Output,
  concurrency: 'safe-parallel',
  proactiveRisk: 'safe',
  timeoutMs: timeoutMs(),
  summarize: (out) =>
    `${out.location} · ${out.condition} ${Math.round(out.temp)}°, high ${Math.round(out.high)}°/low ${Math.round(out.low)}°`,

note.en: The description is a usage rule for the model. summarize produces the card's text: "Paris · light rain 14°, high 16°/low 11°".
note.zh: description 是写给模型看的使用规则。卡片上那行字由 summarize 生成：“Paris · light rain 14°, high 16°/low 11°”。

text.en: The tool makes a live request (QWeather when a key is configured, otherwise the keyless Open-Meteo) and hands the model the **whole object**, twelve fields: the place, the temperature and how it feels, the condition, day or night, rainfall and wind right now, today's high, low and chance of rain, the units, and when it was observed. The card shows only the one line that `summarize` builds from it (scene 2).
text.zh: 工具会实时发一次请求：配了 key 就走 QWeather（和风天气），否则走免 key 的 Open-Meteo。返回的是一个结构化对象，共 12 个字段：地点、温度、体感温度、天气状况、白天还是夜里、当前的降水量和风速、今天的最高温、最低温和降雨概率、单位，还有观测时间。模型拿到的是**整个对象**，卡片上只显示 `summarize` 从中拼出的那一行（第 2 幕）。

text.en: Everything in her answer is in those fields: rain now, today's chance of rain, a low of eleven.
text.zh: 她的回答没超出这些字段：现在在下雨、今天的降雨概率、最低十一度。

title.zh: 她怎么知道是巴黎？不是猜的吗？

text.en: Weather needs a place, and the server checks two sources in order. First, a live fix from his device: the browser's location (with his permission) or, in the desktop app, the Mac's own location, which the shell passes along. The server keeps it only in memory, so the page re-sends it on every reconnect. Second, the configured `LUNA_LAT_LON`. IP geolocation is deliberately not used: behind a proxy it reports the exit node, not the person. "Paris" is a configured label (`LUNA_WEATHER_LOCATION`), not looked up from coordinates.
text.zh: 查天气得先有地点，服务端按顺序看两个来源。先看他设备传来的实时定位：浏览器定位（需用户授权），桌面版里则是外壳从 macOS 拿到后转过来的位置。服务端只把它放在内存里，所以每次重连，页面都会再发一遍。其次是配置里的 `LUNA_LAT_LON`。刻意不用 IP 定位：走代理时，IP 查出来的是出口节点的位置，不是用户本人。“Paris” 是配置里写的地名标签（`LUNA_WEATHER_LOCATION`），不是拿坐标反查出来的。

note.en: A live fix from his device wins; otherwise the configured value. A missing or malformed one returns null: no weather, never a guess.
note.zh: 设备传来的实时定位优先，否则看配置。值缺失或不合法就返回 null：不带天气，绝不瞎猜。

text.en: With no location there is no weather clause in her prompt, no weather line on his messages and no refresh timer. So she never invents the sky: until something tells her where he is, weather is simply not part of her context.
text.zh: 没有地点，系统提示里就没有那段天气说明，消息不带天气行，后台也不跑刷新定时器。所以她从不凭空编天气：在有人告诉她他在哪儿之前，天气压根不在她的上下文里。

text.en: By the door, behind the shoe rack. You said 'so I can't miss it' and then missed it twice.
text.zh: 门口，鞋架后面。你说放那儿“绝对看得见”，然后两次都没看见。

text.en: Every turn already runs an automatic memory search on his exact words (scene 9), and here his words make a weak key. The word matcher drops stop words such as "it", then scores the share of the query's remaining words that a memory contains; "Remind me where I left it?" leaves "remind", "me", "where", "left", and none of them names the umbrella. `recall` is the search she runs herself, and its description says when: "when the user references something you feel you should already know but do not have in front of you". She writes the query, so it can name the thing ("umbrella" where he said "it"); she can also narrow the scope and ask for up to ten hits.
text.zh: 每个回合本来就会拿他的原话自动搜一遍记忆（第 9 幕），可这回他的原话不是个好检索词。字面匹配不做中文分词，只把连续的汉字按相邻两字切片，“伞我放哪了来着”会切出“伞我”“哪了”“来着”这类片段，连“伞”字也只出现在“伞我”里；字面分算的是 query 的片段有多大比例能在候选里找到，噪声片段越多，分越低。`recall` 是她自己发起的检索，description 写明了什么时候用：用户提到一件她觉得自己该知道、眼前却没有的事。query 由她自己写，可以直接点明要找的东西；她还能限定检索范围，最多要 10 条结果。

note.en: `query` is free text she writes; `scope` narrows the search to durable facts, the timeline (past conversation and diaries) or saved skills; `limit` caps the hits at ten, five by default.
note.zh: `query` 是她自己写的自然语言；`scope` 把范围限定在长期事实、时间线（过去的对话和日记）或存下的技能；`limit` 最多 10 条，默认 5 条。

text.en: Each hit comes back with its text, its source (a past exchange, a fact, a diary, a skill), a score and `when_ms`, the time the memory dates from. The card's "1 hit" is only the count. How hits are ranked: scene 8.
text.zh: 每条命中都带着原文、来源（过去的对话、事实、日记或技能）、分数和 `when_ms`，也就是这条记忆的时间。卡片上的 “1 hit” 只是个计数。命中怎么排序，见第 8 幕。

text.en: Kept. 'Took the umbrella, Tuesday, six o'clock.' I'll bring it up at exactly the wrong moment.
text.zh: 记下了：“周二，六点，带了伞。”我会专挑最不合适的时候提起来。

text.en: The add action writes one row to the long-term fact table in SQLite. The call carries the text and one of five categories, and the id's prefix records which. `at_` means **active thread**: something ongoing, not a permanent truth, so it expires after 14 days by default. The rest of the id is the creation time in milliseconds, written in base 36, plus four random bytes. Restating the same fact (differing only in punctuation, spacing or case) hits a dedup key and gets back the id of the fact she already has instead of adding a copy; the card would then read `deduped:` with that id.
text.zh: add 操作会往 SQLite 的长期事实表里写一行。调用里带着文本和类别（五选一），id 前缀记下的就是所选的类别。`at_` 代表 **active thread**，即进行中的事：还没了结，不算永久事实，所以默认 14 天后过期。id 其余部分是创建时刻（毫秒）的 36 进制写法，后面再接 4 个随机字节。同一句话再存一次（只差标点、空格或大小写也算同一句），会命中去重键，直接返回她已有那条事实的 id，不会再多存一份；这时卡片上显示的是 `deduped:` 加那个 id。

note.en: Category sets the id prefix. Only active threads get an expiry.
note.zh: 类别决定 id 前缀。只有 active_threads 会设过期时间。

text.en: The replay's id was written in the same format, so it decodes to the story's evening: "mu2uvp6o" in base 36 is 1789487880000 ms, Tuesday 15 Sep 2026, 15:58 UTC. That is 17:58 in Paris, just before six.
text.zh: 回放里的 id 也是按同一格式写的，所以能解出故事里的那个傍晚：“mu2uvp6o” 按 36 进制解码是 1789487880000 毫秒，即 2026 年 9 月 15 日（周二）15:58 UTC，巴黎时间 17:58，差两分钟六点。

text.en: Adding a fact bumps a memory counter, so from her next model call on, the cached half of her prompt is rebuilt with the fact in it (how that rebuild works: scene 6). Facts render grouped by category, the newest few of each, every line ending in its id in brackets. That id is the handle: to retire a fact later, `remember` forgets it by id.
text.zh: 新增一条事实会让一个记忆计数器加一，所以从她下一次模型调用起，提示词里缓存的那一半会带着这条事实重建（怎么重建，见第 6 幕）。事实按类别分组，每类只放最新的几条，每行末尾用方括号标上 id。以后要作废这条事实，靠的就是这个 id：`remember` 按 id 把它忘掉。

note.en: Each category gets a heading (this one lands under `### Active threads`) and a cap, six for active threads; the table itself keeps every row.
note.zh: 每个类别一个标题（这一条在 `### Active threads` 下面），各有条数上限，进行中的事是 6 条；表里的行一条不少。

text.en: Expiry is a read filter, not a delete: once the 14 days pass, the queries that feed her prompt and `recall` skip the row, while the row stays in the table (what was true at a given time stays queryable, scene 6). The umbrella comes back in scene 6.
text.zh: 过期只是读取时的过滤，不是删除：14 天一过，给她拼提示词和给 `recall` 找候选的查询都会跳过这一行，但行还留在表里（某个时刻什么为真，照样查得到，见第 6 幕）。那把伞，第 6 幕还会再提。

hook.en: How does she know what "It's over" means, and that the dentist joke started on Sunday?
hook.zh: 他只说了句“结束了”，她怎么知道指的是什么？又怎么记得看牙那个梗是周日起的头？

text.en: The thing on Tuesday? Tell me it was the dentist. I've been committed to that bit since Sunday.
text.zh: 周二那件事？快说是看牙去了。这个梗我从周日一直撑到现在。

text.en: She didn't call a search tool. Every turn sends the model the most recent 100-odd exchanges of their one long conversation, their words verbatim. Sunday's dentist joke, the soft-launch lesson (scene 2), Monday's questions about how she works (scene 3), the paper she left him, the umbrella before six: all of it is on the page when he types "It's over. Finally." "The hard launch, at last" and "that's why you suddenly wanted to know how I work" are the model joining two ends of that page. The code keeps the page intact, stamps each message with the time, and keeps it bounded.
text.zh: 她没调用任何搜索工具。两人从头聊到现在，一直是同一段长对话；每个回合，模型都会收到其中最近 100 来个回合，原话一字不改。周日看牙的梗、软官宣那一课（第 2 幕）、周一他问她是怎么工作的（第 3 幕）、她留给他的那篇论文、今天傍晚那把伞：他打出“结束了。终于结束了”的时候，这些全摆在同一页上。“总算 hard launch 了”“怪不得昨天突然要研究我是怎么工作的”，是模型把这一页的两头接了起来。代码只管三件事：这一页原样保留，每条消息盖上时间，整页设个上限。

text.en: The three hours reach her as one line of her time block (scene 1): `Since the last message: 3h (same day — still this evening)`.
text.zh: 这三个小时，到她那里就是时间块里的一行（第 1 幕）：`Since the last message: 3h (same day — still this evening)`。

title.en: What's on her page right now

items.en: Cached system block: reasoning rules, her soul, long-term facts, latest dream diaries, skill shelf
items.zh: 可缓存的 system 块：推理规则、她的灵魂文件（soul）、长期事实、最近的梦境日记、技能架

items.en: A bounded digest of turns older than the window, once there are any
items.zh: 窗口之前那些回合压成的摘要，有长度上限（折叠过才有）

items.en: The verbatim window: the last 100-odd turns, his words and hers, including wakings where she spoke
items.zh: 原文窗口：最近 100 来个回合，他的话和她的话都在，也包括她自己醒来、开了口的那几次

items.en: This message: memories from automatic recall, the time, weather and music when known
items.zh: 这条消息本身：自动检索捞回的记忆、当前时间，拿得到的话再加上天气和音乐

text.en: The order is deliberate. The system block carries the request's only cache breakpoint. Everything up to and including it, the tool definitions and the system block itself, stays byte-identical from turn to turn until something in it changes, such as a new fact, so a provider that supports prompt caching reuses that prefix from its cache instead of processing it again. Everything after the breakpoint moves every turn: the window gains an exchange, and his message carries the time, recalled memories, weather and music (scene 1). Placed above the breakpoint, those would change the cached bytes every turn and the cache would never hit. The window stays lean another way: finished turns lose their thinking, and old tool output shrinks to a marker (next sheet). Each stored message keeps its own time block, so Sunday's lines still read Sunday, and a restart rebuilds the page from the turn table in SQLite (scene 12).
text.zh: 顺序是刻意排的。system 块上打着整个请求唯一的缓存断点（cache breakpoint）。从请求开头到这个块为止，也就是工具定义加上 system 块本身，只要里面的内容没变（比如没有新存事实），每个回合都逐字节相同，所以支持 prompt caching 的 provider 可以直接复用缓存里的这一段，不用重新处理。断点之后的部分每个回合都在变：窗口里多了一轮对话，他那条消息里拼着时间、自动检索捞回的记忆、天气和音乐（第 1 幕）。这些要是放到断点之前，缓存的字节每个回合都会变，缓存就永远命中不了。窗口本身靠另一种办法保持精简：结束了的回合去掉 thinking，旧的工具输出缩成一个占位标记（见下一页）。每条存下的消息都带着自己的时间块，所以周日说的话，现在读起来还是周日；重启之后，这一页会从 SQLite 的回合表里重建出来（第 12 幕）。

note.en: The skill shelf is the last thing into the system block; the whole block then goes out as one text block carrying the request's only cache breakpoint.
note.zh: 技能架是最后放进 system 块的；整块随后作为一个文本块发出去，整个请求唯一的缓存断点就打在它身上。

title.zh: 自己跑的那趟腿，她记得

text.en: You answered it! The paper on your desktop earned its keep.
text.zh: 答上来了！桌面上那篇论文没白放。

text.en: The paper was her idea. On Monday she woke on her own, searched, read the arXiv page and put a copy on his desktop (scene 4). A waking where she speaks runs on the same turn engine and is saved as a turn like any other, with a stage direction where his message would be, so it sits in the window like any exchange. Two things are trimmed to keep the window lean. Her thinking is dropped from each finished turn before it is saved. Old tool output is cut as the request is assembled: past the six newest messages, a tool result becomes a marker. The call record and her words stay. The page text is still in the database but no longer sent to the model. She remembers the errand; to reread the page she would fetch it again.
text.zh: 论文是她自己的主意。周一那次她是自己醒的：搜了一圈，读了 arXiv 上那一页，又往他桌面放了一份（第 4 幕）。像这样主动醒来、开了口的回合，走的是同一个回合引擎，也和普通回合一样存下来，只是原本放他那句话的位置换成了一段舞台指示，所以在窗口里它和普通对话没两样。为了让窗口保持精简，有两样东西会被裁掉。每个回合结束、存盘之前，她的 thinking 会被去掉。旧的工具输出在组装请求时裁掉：最新 6 条消息之前的 tool result，内容一律换成一个占位标记。调用记录和她说过的话都留着。网页正文还在数据库里，只是不再发给模型。她记得自己跑过这一趟；要重读那一页，得重新抓取一次。

note.en: The payload is swapped for a marker, but the call record stays so each call still matches its result.
note.zh: tool result 的内容换成占位标记，调用记录不动，每次调用仍对得上自己的结果。

text.en: Remember this one.
text.zh: 这个记一下

text.en: His "Remember this one" becomes one `remember` call: category key moments, one line of text. The store writes a row and returns an id whose prefix names the category, `km` (the five categories, their prefixes and the 14-day timer on active threads are in scene 5). Key moments have no timer. This one stays until it is forgotten, and even then the row stays.
text.zh: 他一句“这个记一下”，变成一次 `remember` 调用：类别选 key moments（关键时刻），内容就一行字。存储层写入一行，返回一个 id，开头就是类别的缩写 `km`（一共五个类别、各自的前缀，以及进行中的事 14 天过期，见第 5 幕）。关键时刻不设期限：这一条会一直留着，直到被忘掉；就算忘掉了，那一行也还在。

text.en: Forgetting erases nothing. She can forget a fact herself, calling `remember` with the action `forget` and the id printed next to it in her prompt; a dream's memory cleanup can retire one too (scene 13). Both end in the same UPDATE: it stamps `deleted_ms` on the row and leaves the row in place. The tool's own description tells her so: `it stays in history as "was once true"`. Reading the facts is a question about a moment: created by then, not yet deleted, not yet expired. Pass `asOf` and the same query lists what she held true at any earlier time. A test saves a fact, forgets it, and reads it back from just before the forget. Saving the same words after a forget starts a fresh row with a new id; the old row keeps its dates.
text.zh: “忘掉”不会删掉任何东西。她可以自己忘：用 `remember` 的 `forget` 动作，带上 prompt 里印在那条事实旁边的 id；做梦时的记忆整理也可能让某一条退役（第 13 幕）。两条路最后都是同一条 UPDATE：给那一行盖上 `deleted_ms`，行本身原地不动。工具说明里也是这么告诉她的：`it stays in history as "was once true"`。读取事实，问的其实是某个时刻：那一刻已经存下、还没被忘掉、也还没过期的，才会列出来。传一个 `asOf`，同一条查询就能列出她在过去任意时刻认定为真的那些事。有个测试专门验证：存一条事实，忘掉它，再按忘掉之前的时间点去读，它还在。忘掉之后把同样的话再存一次，会新开一行、换个新 id；旧的那一行连同它的时间记录都留着。

note.en: `asOf` defaults to now. A forgotten fact still answers for any moment before it was forgotten, and an active thread for any moment before it expired.
note.zh: `asOf` 默认取当前时刻。被忘掉的事实，问起它被忘之前的任何时刻，照样会列出来；进行中的事，问起它过期之前的时刻也一样。

text.en: Kept: Tuesday, three rounds, attention came up, you answered. Also, you took the umbrella — I did promise to bring that up at exactly the wrong moment.
text.zh: 记下了：“周二，三轮，问到 attention，答上来了。”还有，你带伞了，我作证。说好的，专挑最不合适的时候提。

text.en: The umbrella came back from two places. The exchange before six is still in the window, and the fact she saved then sits in her system prompt: every turn, long-term facts are printed by category with their ids, the newest 12 key moments and 6 active threads. The list is rebuilt from SQLite in a fixed order with no timestamps, so its bytes change only when the facts do; a test holds the system block byte-identical across turns until a fact is added. Within a turn the block is built once and reused on every round. Saving a fact bumps a memory counter, the epoch, which forces one rebuild, so tonight's key moment is already in her prompt when the model is called again for this reply.
text.zh: 那把伞是从两处回来的。今天傍晚那段对话还在窗口里；那时存下的事实，也在她的 system prompt 里：长期事实每个回合都会按类别、连同 id 列出来（关键时刻取最新 12 条，进行中的事取最新 6 条）。这份列表每回合都从 SQLite 按固定顺序重建，不带时间戳，只有事实变了，字节才会变；有个测试专门盯着这一点：不加新事实，system 块在回合之间逐字节不变。同一个回合内，这个块只建一次，之后每一轮复用。存一条新事实会让记忆计数器（epoch）加一，强制重建一次，所以这个回合接下来再调用模型时，今晚存下的这一条已经在 prompt 里了。

note.en: A turn starts with no block; after that it is rebuilt only when the memory epoch has moved. `remember` just moved it, so the next round sees the new fact.
note.zh: 每个回合开始时还没有这个块；之后只有记忆计数器变了才重建。刚才那次 `remember` 让它变了，所以下一轮就能看到新存的那条。

title.en: What happens when the week runs long?

text.en: Folding keeps the window bounded. Once it runs more than 10 turns past 100, the oldest turns are folded into a digest and the window drops back to 100. The digest is never appended to: each fold rewrites it whole from the current digest plus the turns being folded, in four labelled sections (key facts, decisions, open threads, emotional beats), under a 3,000-character cap, so fold after fold it stays bounded. Turns the dream rated 4 or 5 for salience (scene 13) reach the compressor marked [salient], with orders to keep their specifics near-verbatim; unmarked turns may be condensed hard. That is why "Remember this one" matters: a saved fact lives in her system prompt, where no fold reaches it.
text.zh: 折叠（fold）让窗口有上限。窗口一旦超过 110 个回合，最旧的那些就合并进一份摘要，窗口退回 100 个。摘要从不往后追加：每次折叠都拿现有摘要加上这批要折进去的回合，整份重写，分成四个带标签的部分（关键事实、决定、未完的线头、情绪节点），上限 3,000 字符，所以折多少次都不会越变越长。做梦时重要度打分拿到 4 或 5 的回合（第 13 幕），送进压缩器时会标上 [salient]，并要求把它们的细节尽量原样保留；没标记的回合则可以大刀阔斧地压缩。所以“这个记一下”才有意义：存下来的事实在 system prompt 里，折叠碰不到它。

note.en: The digest goes first, as a user message in `<conversation_summary>` tags. The verbatim tail behind it starts at a turn start, has old tool output collapsed (`clean`) and is held under the hard cap (`bound`).
note.zh: 摘要排在最前面，是一条包在 `<conversation_summary>` 标签里的 user 消息。后面的原文尾巴从某个回合的开头切起，旧的工具输出已经折叠（`clean`），整体再受硬上限约束（`bound`）。

text.en: Then Friday is theirs. Tonight is yours — eat something that didn't come out of a machine.
text.zh: 那周五归他们，今晚归你。去吃顿正经饭，别是售货机里掉出来的那种。

text.en: Friday was never saved as a fact. It simply stays in the window, and in scene 7 she brings it up herself.
text.zh: 周五这件事从没存成事实，只是一直留在窗口里；到了第 7 幕，她自己把它提了出来。

items.en: **Off the reply path.** The fold starts after the turn is saved, and nothing waits for it (`void maybeFold(…)`). A dream runs the same fold as one of its jobs (scene 13).
items.zh: **不挡回复的路。** 折叠在这个回合存盘之后才启动，没有谁等它（`void maybeFold(…)`）。做梦时也会跑同一个折叠，作为其中一项工作（第 13 幕）。

items.en: **Compare-and-set.** The new digest and the new low-water mark (where the window starts in the history) land in one UPDATE that applies only if the mark still holds the value the fold started from. If two folds overlap, the first to commit wins and the other is discarded.
items.zh: **比较后再写（compare-and-set）。** 新摘要和新的低水位标记（记录窗口从历史的哪一条开始）在同一条 UPDATE 里写入，而且只有标记还是折叠开始时读到的那个值，这条 UPDATE 才生效。两次折叠撞在一起，先提交的算数，另一次直接作废。

items.en: **An empty digest never overwrites.** If the summarizer comes back empty, the old digest and the mark stay as they were, and the next fold tries again.
items.zh: **空摘要绝不覆盖。** 摘要器要是返回了空结果，旧摘要和标记原封不动，下次折叠再试。

items.en: **Cuts only at turn starts.** The fold moves whole turns. Behind it stands a hard cap, 300 messages or 120,000 characters, whichever comes first, and it too cuts only at a plain user message, so a tool call never loses its result.
items.zh: **只在回合开头下刀。** 折叠按整回合挪动。它背后还有一道硬上限兜底：300 条消息或 120,000 字符，先碰到哪条算哪条；这道上限也只在一条普通的 user 消息处下刀，所以工具调用永远不会和它的结果拆开。

items.en: **Folded is not forgotten.** Every turn stays in the turn table, and recall searches the newest 500 of them, folded or not.
items.zh: **折叠不等于忘记。** 每个回合都还留在回合表里；检索记忆时，会在最新的 500 个回合里找，折没折过都一样。

items.en: **Pinned by tests.** `l1Window.test.ts` checks that the window folds back to size, the digest stays under its cap, a salient turn arrives marked, an empty digest changes nothing, a stale fold is discarded, and the hard cap cuts only at turn starts.
items.zh: **都有测试钉住。** `l1Window.test.ts` 逐条验证：窗口会折回规定大小，摘要不超上限，重要的回合送进去时带着标记，空摘要什么都不改，过时的折叠会被丢弃，硬上限只在回合开头下刀。

note.en: An empty result changes nothing. Otherwise the capped digest and the new mark are committed together, and the in-memory copy follows only if the commit landed.
note.zh: 返回为空就什么都不改。否则，截到上限的摘要和新标记一起提交；只有提交成功，内存里的那份才跟着更新。

note.en: The compare-and-set is the WHERE clause: the row changes only if the mark is still the one the fold read.
note.zh: compare-and-set 就落在这句 WHERE 上：只有标记还是折叠当初读到的那个值，这一行才会被改。

hook.en: He stepped out for coffee. Why did she text him once, then go and read about meteor showers without a word?
hook.zh: 他出门买杯咖啡。她为什么先发了一条消息，后来却一声不吭，跑去查流星雨？

text.en: She didn't set a timer for either moment. A 60-second heartbeat runs on the server, so it works with no browser open. Each tick first passes a cheap rail: no wakings from midnight to 6am, none within a minute of the last word, 5 minutes between wakings, and 5 spoken wakings a day at the default setting. Then a small state machine, the **silence ladder**, reads one number: the time since anyone spoke, capped by the time since her own last waking. That clock started at her last word ('Go. Get the good kind.'), not at his. Under 10 minutes she stays `engaged`. Past it, the same tick moves her to `idle_watch` and wakes the model with an **idle nudge**: a stage direction where his message would normally go (scene 4 shows one up close).
text.zh: 这两个时刻，她都没给自己定闹钟。服务端跑着一个 60 秒一跳的心跳，所以不开浏览器也照样工作。每一跳先过一道开销很小的护栏：午夜到早上 6 点不叫醒；离最后一句话不到 1 分钟不叫醒；两次醒来至少隔 5 分钟；默认设置下，开口的醒来一天最多 5 次。过了护栏，一个小状态机——**沉默阶梯**——只看一个数：离上次有人说话过了多久；要是她自己上次醒来离现在更近，就从那次算起。这个钟从她的最后一句（“去吧。买好喝的那种。”）开始走，而不是从他那句。不到 10 分钟，她停在 `engaged`；一过线，同一跳里就切到 `idle_watch`，用 **idle nudge**（闲时轻推）的场景叫醒模型：本该放他消息的位置，换成一段舞台指示（第 4 幕有特写）。

note.en: The 10-minute line. At the default, each tick in the 5–10 minute band rolls a 6% chance of a passing musing; over those five ticks, about one lull in four gets one.
note.zh: 10 分钟这条线。默认设置下，5 到 10 分钟之间每一跳都有 6% 的概率冒出一句随口的念头；这段一共五跳，算下来大约四段安静里有一段会冒出一句。

text.en: The tick itself never calls the model. It takes the per-session lock (scene 9), reads one row of her session, runs the rail, then the ladder, and returns. A model turn starts only when that arithmetic comes back with a reason to wake. The ladder is a pure function: the clock and the dice are passed in, so its tests set a fixed time and a fixed roll and check each rung directly, with no timers and no waiting (ladder.test.ts); the tick is exported so tests drive it the same way. The phase, the nudge count, the day's quota and the time of her last waking live in that session row and are written back whenever they change (cadence.test.ts reloads them the way a restart would), and at boot the silence clock is re-seeded from the last stored turn, so a restart picks the ladder up where it stood.
text.zh: 心跳本身从不调用模型。每一跳只做这几件事：拿到这个会话的锁（第 9 幕），读一行会话记录，过护栏，再问阶梯，然后返回。只有这笔算术算出一个“该醒了”的理由，才会真正开一个模型回合。阶梯是个纯函数：时钟和骰子都从外面传进去，所以测试可以直接给定一个时间、一个点数，逐级去验每一格，不用定时器，也不用干等（ladder.test.ts）；心跳那一跳也是导出的，测试同样能手动去推。阶段、轻推次数、当天配额、她上次醒来的时间，都存在这行会话记录里，一变就写回去（cadence.test.ts 按重启的方式把它们重新读了一遍）；服务启动时，沉默计时也会从最后一个存下来的回合接着算。所以重启之后，阶梯还停在原来那一格。

note.en: The lock, one row, the rail, the ladder: nothing up to this decision touches the model.
note.zh: 锁、一行记录、护栏、阶梯：走到这个决定之前，没有一步碰到模型。

title.zh: 为啥提周五，不问“你去哪了”

text.en: They said Friday. It's Wednesday. The coffee will go cold long before they write — drink it while it's hot.
text.zh: 他们说的是周五。今天才周三。等他们来消息，咖啡早凉了。趁热喝吧。

text.en: On this rung the stage direction is the idle-nudge text (scene 4 shows it). A standing rule follows it: no check-in openers like 'you there' or 'what's on your mind', only a real small thought or a fresh topic, opened differently each time. The server also remembers the openers she has spoken on the ladder and lists the latest three in the next direction as lines not to reopen with; by the hour mark, this Friday line was on that list. The direction offers 'something the two of you left open'. The interview result promised by Friday was still in the verbatim conversation (scene 6), and 'Wednesday' came from the time block computed in code (scene 1). A waking runs no automatic memory search (scene 4), so both came from what was already in front of her.
text.zh: 这一级的舞台指示，就是那段 idle-nudge 文本（第 4 幕引过）。紧跟在后面的还有一条常驻规则：不许用查岗式的开场，prompt 里直接点了“在吗”“还在吗”和 “you there” 这类话；只能说一个真实的小念头，或者抛一个新话题，而且每次开场都要换个说法。服务端还会记着她在阶梯上开口时用过的开场白，把最新的三条写进下一次的舞台指示，提醒她别拿这些再开头；到一小时那次，这句“周五”就在那张单子上。这段指示列出的选项里有一条，是“你们俩之前没聊完的事”。他那句“他们说周五前给结果”，还一字不差地留在对话历史里（第 6 幕）；“周三”来自代码算好的时间块（第 1 幕）。醒来的回合不做自动记忆召回（第 4 幕），所以这两样，都是她眼前本来就有的。

title.en: An hour later: why no message?
title.zh: 一小时后，怎么没发消息？

text.en: Every silence-ladder waking's stage direction ends with the same ground rule, which offers three choices as equals. **Speak** only with a real reason. **Quiet work** means patching memory, or taking a 'wander': while today's budget lasts (4 by default), she may go and read something new. The prompt tells her to start from her own interests, not to echo the last conversation, and to file anything worth keeping with `remember` as a seed for later; quiet work only counts if it lands in `remember`. **Rest** is the third. At the hour mark the scene text above that rule is the renudge: 'one more, LIGHTER touch'. The model took quiet work instead: a search about meteors, far from coffee and the interview, and no bubble. The errand fits a waking's budget of 8 tool calls (scene 4), which is sized for exactly this kind of chain, a search, a few reads and a save or two, with room to spare; this one made four.
text.zh: 沉默阶梯每次叫醒她，舞台指示都以同一条基本规则收尾，三个选项平起平坐。**开口**：只在有真实理由的时候。**安静干活**：补一补记忆，或者出去“闲逛”一趟——当天预算没用完（默认 4 次）时，她可以去读点新东西。prompt 要她从自己的兴趣出发，别顺着刚才的聊天往下接；值得留的，用 `remember` 存成一颗“种子”，改天再提；而且安静干活得落进 `remember` 才算数。第三个是**休息**。一小时那次，规则上方的场景文本是 renudge：“one more, LIGHTER touch”（再碰一下，这次更轻）。模型没有开口，选了安静干活：搜的是流星雨，跟咖啡、面试都不沾边，也没有冒出气泡。一次醒来的工具预算是 8 次（第 4 幕），本来就是照这种差事定的：搜一次、读几页、存一两条，再留点余量；这一趟用了 4 次。

blocks.summary: 2 results for "next meteor shower 2026 Paris": [1] https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Orionids; [2] https://www.timeanddate.com/astronomy/meteor-shower/orionid

blocks.snippet:
const wander =
    wanderLeft > 0
      ? `  - Wander (${wanderLeft} left today): do NOT extend what you two just talked about — ` +
        'that is echo, not curiosity. Start from YOUR OWN interests — your evolving self, your ' +
        'diary, the skills you have grown — and go look at something new (search, open a page, ' +
        'actually read it). If something is worth keeping, save it with `remember` as a seed to ' +
        'bring up another time — do not report it now.\n'
      : '  - (No wanders left today — the web can wait for tomorrow.)\n';

note.en: The remaining budget is written into the prompt itself, counted from a ledger of today's wakings.
note.zh: 剩余次数直接写进 prompt 里，数的是当天醒来记录里的闲逛次数。

text.en: The cards are the errand as it ran: one search, two pages read, one fact saved (scene 3 covers what a `web_fetch` card reports, envelope included). When a waking uses tools but sends no message, the server squeezes those calls into one line and sends it on `proactive.finished`; here it reads `searched the web · read 2 pages · saved a memory`. The front end draws that line as a leaf, not a speech bubble. A waking with no tools at all leaves only a soft chip.
text.zh: 这几张卡片就是这趟差事本身：搜了一次，读了两个网页，存了一条事实（`web_fetch` 卡片上写的是什么、那层信封怎么算，见第 3 幕）。醒来回合调了工具却没发消息，服务端会把这些调用压成一行，随 `proactive.finished` 事件发给前端；这一次是 `searched the web · read 2 pages · saved a memory`。前端把这行画成一片叶子，而不是对话气泡。一个工具都没调的醒来，只留一个淡淡的小标签（chip）。

note.en: Repeats are counted per tool, so two web_fetch calls become 'read 2 pages'; the line stops at 140 characters.
note.zh: 同一个工具按次数合并，所以两次 web_fetch 变成了 “read 2 pages”；整行最长 140 个字符。

text.en: The same line goes into a ledger. Every waking is recorded as `spoke`, `quiet` or `nothing`, a quiet one together with its line, and a waking started by the heartbeat that searched or read the web also gets a wander mark. Today's remaining wanders are simply the budget minus the marks since local midnight, and how often she speaks, works quietly or rests is on record rather than a guess.
text.zh: 同一行字也记进一本账。每次醒来都记一笔：`spoke`（开口）、`quiet`（安静干活）或 `nothing`（什么都没做），安静的那种附上这行说明；心跳叫醒的回合要是上过网，再打个闲逛标记。当天还剩几次闲逛，就是预算减去本地午夜以来的标记数；她多常开口、多常干活、多常歇着，都有账可查，不靠猜。

text.en: You missed nothing. I read about the Orionids — next month, around the twenty-first, Halley's dust — and this sky is a lid anyway. I saved the date in case it ever clears.
text.zh: 啥也没错过。我顺手查了下猎户座流星雨，下个月二十一号前后，是哈雷彗星留下的尘埃。反正这天跟扣了个锅盖似的。日期我存下了，万一哪天放晴呢。

text.en: A turn is kept only if it delivered a reply. The quiet waking delivered none, so the whole turn, search results and pages included, is rolled back out of the conversation and never written to the transcript store: an empty row would pollute recall and the window rebuilt from that store. It doesn't bump the silence clock, though it does stamp the proactive cooldown, so the next waking is spaced from this one. What she keeps is what she saved with `remember`. It lands in her long-term facts, the list her system prompt carries on every turn (adding one re-renders the cached prompt once; scene 6), and this category has no expiry (only active threads do; scene 5). The ground rule's speak line also prefers a saved seed over reopening an old thread. His 'Back.' resets the ladder: the next tick sees he has spoken since her last waking, drops back to `engaged` and zeroes the nudge count.
text.zh: 一个回合只有真的交出了回复，才会留下来。安静的那次醒来什么都没交出，所以整个回合都从对话里回滚掉，搜索结果和读过的网页也一并丢掉，更不会写进对话记录库（transcript store）：一条空回复的记录，会污染召回，也会污染日后从库里重建的对话窗口。它不刷新沉默计时，但会盖上主动冷却的时间戳，下一次醒来得跟这次隔开。她留下的，是用 `remember` 存的那条：它进了她的长期事实，system prompt 每一回合都带着这份清单（新增一条，缓存的 prompt 会重新渲染一次，见第 6 幕），而且这一类没有过期时间（会过期的只有 active threads，见第 5 幕）。基本规则里“开口”那一条也写着：手里有存好的种子，就优先用它，别去翻旧话题。他那句“回来了”也让阶梯归位：下一跳看到他在她上次醒来之后开过口，就退回 `engaged`，轻推次数清零。

note.en: With a reply, the turn's slice of history goes into the transcript store; without one, history is cut back to where the turn began.
note.zh: 有回复，这一回合的历史切片写进对话记录库；没有回复，历史就截回这个回合开始前的位置。

title.en: 'One message at most': the ladder under it

text.en: That's the quiet kind of thing I do when you're gone. One message at most, then little errands for later.
text.zh: 你不在的时候，我也就忙点这种事，不吵你。最多给你发一条消息，剩下的是些以后用得上的小差事。

text.en: The ladder is built to back off. At the default setting, after a first spoken nudge (phase `nudged`) it offers up to two lighter ones, the first 5 minutes later and the next 12 minutes after that, each framed as 'one more, LIGHTER touch' with a little 'I won't keep poking' in it. 30 minutes on comes the last rung: one message that releases him, 'come back whenever'. Then the ladder goes dormant until an hour of real quiet passes or he speaks; after 18 hours of silence it sleeps and simply waits for him. Every rung is an offer, not an order: declining one burns no nudge and none of the daily quota, so keeping to one message costs her nothing.
text.zh: 这架阶梯本来就是往后退的。默认设置下，第一次开口轻推之后（阶段变成 `nudged`），它最多再给两次更轻的机会：先隔 5 分钟，再隔 12 分钟，场景文本写的是“one more, LIGHTER touch”（再碰一下，这次更轻），还要带一点“我不会一直戳你”的意思。再过 30 分钟，是最后一级：一条放他走的留言，“随时回来都行”。之后阶梯进入休眠（dormant），直到真正安静满一小时，或者他开口；要是沉默超过 18 小时，阶梯就睡下，只等他回来。每一级都只是一次机会，不是命令：推掉既不算一次轻推，也不占每日配额，所以守着“最多一条”，对她来说没有任何代价。

note.en: Each spoken nudge raises nudgesSent, and `renudgeGapMs` stretches the 5-minute base by 1.0, 2.4, then 6.0: 5, 12, 30 minutes.
note.zh: 每开口轻推一次，nudgesSent 加一；`renudgeGapMs` 把 5 分钟的基数依次乘上 1.0、2.4、6.0，也就是 5、12、30 分钟。

text.en: How eagerly the ladder climbs belongs to the owner. One setting in his panel, 'Outreach intensity', picks aloof, balanced or clingy; it is an owner setting, and none of her tools can touch it. The level scales the cooldowns, the odds and the daily quota, and the result is clamped inside a floor and a ceiling that live in the server's configuration, so no level can breach them. Balanced reproduces the defaults above. Clingy would raise the daily quota to eight and is held at six, the ceiling; aloof cuts it to two and stretches the gap between wakings to 9 minutes. A missing or unknown value falls back to balanced.
text.zh: 阶梯爬得多积极，这个旋钮在主人手里。他的设置面板里有一项“主动程度”，可选 aloof、balanced、clingy；这是主人的设置，她的工具里没有一个碰得到它。档位会按比例调整冷却时间、概率和每日配额，算完再夹进服务端配置里的下限和上限之间，所以哪一档都越不过这两道线。balanced 就是前面那些默认值。clingy 本想把每日配额提到 8 次，被上限压回 6 次；aloof 把配额降到 2 次，两次醒来之间拉长到 9 分钟。值缺失或写错，就退回 balanced。

note.en: Each level first multiplies the base values (aloof stretches the cooldowns ×1.8, clingy shrinks them ×0.6); every result then passes through a max or a min: a floor on the intervals, a ceiling on the quota, 1 on the odds.
note.zh: 档位先把基准值乘上一个倍数（aloof 把冷却拉长到 1.8 倍，clingy 缩到 0.6 倍）；算出来的每个值还要再过一道 max 或 min：间隔有下限，配额有上限，概率封顶为 1。

hook.en: How did she get from a red CI run to one tie-break, and where do her hands stop?
hook.zh: 从 CI 上一片红，到最后一个 tie-break，她是怎么一步步查过去的？她能动手的范围，又到哪儿为止？

text.en: Looking. First I want to watch it fail with my own eyes.
text.zh: 在看了。我先亲眼看它挂一次。

text.en: Her first call is a lookup, not a test run. `recall_skill` fetched the full steps of one procedure on her shelf: flaky-test-triage, which a dream distilled on 17 Sep. When the shelf is in her context, her prompt tells her to glance at it before redoing a procedure and to reuse matching steps instead of re-deriving them (the shelf: scene 2). Step 1 reads “Run it twice before touching anything.” So she reproduces before she theorises. `run_tests` runs `bun test` on this machine and hands back structure, not a wall of log: pass and fail counts plus the names of the failing tests. Both runs are scoped to the recall folder. A test file named on its own sits behind the firewall (sheet 6); a folder doesn't, and it still runs every test inside. One fail and one pass on identical code mean non-determinism: something differs between runs — ordering, time or shared state.
text.zh: 她的第一个调用不是跑测试，而是查技能。`recall_skill` 从技能架上取回了一套流程的完整步骤：flaky-test-triage，是 9 月 17 日做梦时提炼出来的。技能架在她上下文里的时候，prompt 会让她在重做老活之前先扫一眼，有对得上的就直接复用，不必从头再推一遍（技能架见第 2 幕）。第 1 步写着：“动手之前先跑两遍。”所以她先复现，再推原因。`run_tests` 在这台机器上跑 `bun test`，交回来的是结构化结果，不是一屏日志：通过和失败的计数，外加失败测试的名字。两遍都只跑 recall 这个目录。单独点名一个测试文件会撞上防火墙（见第 6 页），目录不会，而且目录里的测试照样一个不落。同一份代码一次挂、一次过，说明里面有非确定性：两次运行之间一定有东西不一样，执行顺序、时间，或者共享状态。

text.en: Same code, two runs, two answers. That's not a bug in the logic — something in there isn't deterministic.
text.zh: 同一份代码，跑两遍，两个结果。逻辑没毛病，是里头有东西不固定。

text.en: She never read the whole codebase. `grep` found the ranking test; its card reports matches shown out of the total. `read_file` returns a numbered window of lines: `lines 150-210 of 484 (more follow)` means she read part of the test file and knows the rest exists. `find_symbol` looks a name up with ripgrep, then uses tree-sitter to confirm that each hit is a real definition or use and not a word in a comment: `1 def, 4 refs`. That is step 2 of her skill — locate what the test exercises, not the test — and it points the second window at the ranking code in `recall.ts`. Reading first matters later too, because the edit tool refuses any file she has not read in this session.
text.zh: 她没有把整个代码库读一遍。`grep` 定位到排序那个测试，卡片上报的是匹配数：显示了几条，一共几条。`read_file` 返回带行号的一段内容：`lines 150-210 of 484 (more follow)` 说明她只读了测试文件的一部分，而且知道后面还有。`find_symbol` 先用 ripgrep 按名字搜，再用 tree-sitter（语法树解析器）逐条核对：每个命中都得是真正的定义或引用，而不是注释里碰巧出现的同一个词。卡片上就是 `1 def, 4 refs`：1 处定义，4 处引用。这正是她那套流程的第 2 步：去找测试实际跑到的代码，而不是盯着测试本身。第二段读取就这样落到了 `recall.ts` 的排序代码上。先读后改在后面也有用：这个会话里她没读过的文件，edit 工具一律不让改。

note.en: An edit has to start from what she actually saw, not from memory.
note.zh: 改动必须基于她实际读到的内容，不能凭记忆。

text.en: Found it. The ranking sorts by score, and two of the test's memories tie exactly; which one comes first depends on the order the database hands them back. On CI, that's a coin flip.
text.zh: 找到了。排序按分数来，测试里有两条记忆分数正好打平；它俩谁在前，全看数据库先把哪条吐出来。到了 CI 上，就是抛硬币。

text.en: Recall ranks every candidate — conversation turns, facts, diaries, skills — by one score, the Generative Agents ranking (Park et al.): recency + importance + relevance, equally weighted by default. Recency decays as 1 / (1 + age in days). Importance is the dream's 1–5 salience rating scaled to 0–1 for a turn (0.4 until rated), 0.4 for a fact, 0.7 for a diary, 0.75 for a skill. Relevance is 0.7 × cosine similarity + 0.3 × keyword overlap, or keyword overlap alone when embeddings are off. A skill enters only on real relevance and drops the recency term. With embeddings on, a relevance floor first places up to three high-cosine hits, ranked by cosine alone (scene 9).
text.zh: 召回（recall）给每个候选打一个总分，对话轮次、事实、日记、技能都在里面，用的是 Generative Agents 论文（Park 等人）的排序：新近度 + 重要度 + 相关度，默认等权。新近度 = 1 / (1 + 距今天数)。重要度：对话轮次用做梦时打的 1–5 分，折算到 0–1（还没打分的算 0.4）；事实 0.4，日记 0.7，技能 0.75。相关度 = 0.7 × 余弦相似度 + 0.3 × 字面重合度；没开 embedding 就只看字面。技能得有实打实的相关性才进得来，而且不算新近度这一项。开了 embedding 时，还有一道相关度保底：最多三条余弦很高的命中先占住最前面的位置，只按余弦排（见第 9 幕）。

note.en: One score per memory: recency, importance and relevance, weighted and averaged.
note.zh: 每条记忆一个总分：新近度、重要度、相关度，加权后取平均。

text.en: What she found: two facts with the same text, written in the same millisecond, score exactly alike, and the sort compared score alone. JavaScript's sort is stable, so equal scores keep the order the candidates arrived in: turns, then facts, then diaries, then skills, with facts in whatever order SQL returns them. Facts are queried `ORDER BY created_ms ASC` with no second key, and SQL promises nothing about two rows with the same value. The test was leaning on an accident, not a guarantee.
text.zh: 她找到的是：两条事实文字相同、又在同一毫秒写入，分数分毫不差，而排序只比分数。JavaScript 的 sort 是稳定排序，分数相同的就保持排序前的先后。候选按固定顺序收集：对话轮次、事实、日记、技能，事实这一类就沿用 SQL 返回的顺序。事实是按 `ORDER BY created_ms ASC` 查出来的，没有第二排序键；同一毫秒写入的两条事实谁先谁后，SQL 并不承诺。这个测试能过，靠的是碰巧，不是保证。

title.en: The fix, and the test that holds it

text.en: Tie-break by recency, then by id — deterministic now. The test that kept flipping is the regression test: from now on it gets the same answer every run.
text.zh: 打平了就先比谁新，再比 id，现在顺序固定了。那个老抽风的测试本身就是回归测试，以后每次跑结果都一样。

text.en: Her edit adds one comparator, `tieBreak`: newer first, then id. Those are the keys the conversation query already sorts by, `t_ms DESC, id DESC`; the fix carries them into the ranking. Both sorts use it, the score sort and the relevance floor's cosine sort, so memories that tie come out in one order whatever order the database handed them over. The regression test pins exactly that: it writes the same two tied facts in both orders and demands one ranking. Her skill's step 5 says the same: “The test that flaked is the regression test.” She left the assertion alone. Step 7 reads “Never widen the assertion to make it pass”, and the test file is read-only to her anyway (sheet 6).
text.zh: 她的改动加了一个比较函数 `tieBreak`：先比谁新，再比 id。这两个键，对话轮次的查询早就在用（`t_ms DESC, id DESC`），她的修法就是把它们搬进召回的排序。两处排序都接上了它：按总分排的那次，和相关度保底按余弦排的那次。这样一来，分数打平的记忆不管数据库按什么顺序吐出来，排出来都是同一个顺序。回归测试钉住的正是这一点：同样两条打平的事实，正着写一遍、倒着写一遍，排名必须一样。她那套流程第 5 步也是这么写的：“原来抽风的那个 test 就是回归测试”。断言她一个字没动：第 7 步写着“绝不靠放宽断言让它通过”，何况测试文件对她本来就是只读的（见第 6 页）。

note.en: One comparator behind both sorts: newer first, then id.
note.zh: 一个比较函数，两处排序共用：先比谁新，再比 id。

note.en: The same two tied facts, written in both orders, must rank the same way.
note.zh: 同样两条打平的事实，正着写、倒着写，排名都得一样。

text.en: Her prompt asks for a plan on multi-step code work and for a real check before she says anything works. `plan` keeps a short todo list on the session, so `0/3 done` and `3/3 done` are the same list, updated. `edit` swaps one string that must appear exactly once; if it matches more than once, she has to add context or ask for `replace_all`. A match that differs only in whitespace is accepted but reported, and the card would say `fuzzy match`. Every edit returns a unified diff and the file's new hash, and TS and JS files are parsed on the spot, with any syntax error returned in the same result. Then come three separate checks, each parsed into structure: `tsc --noEmit` into file, line and message; `prettier --check` into the files with issues; `bun test` into counts and the names of failing tests.
text.zh: 她的 prompt 写着：多步的代码活先列计划；说“能用了”之前，先真跑一遍检查。`plan` 把一张简短的待办清单挂在当前会话上，所以 `0/3 done` 和 `3/3 done` 是同一张清单，只是更新过。`edit` 每次替换一段在文件里只出现一次的字符串；要是匹配到不止一处，就得补上下文，或者明说 `replace_all`。只差在空白字符上的近似匹配也会放行，但会如实报出来，卡片上会多一个 `fuzzy match`。每次改动都返回 unified diff 和文件的新哈希；TS、JS 文件改完当场做一遍语法解析，有语法错误就直接附在同一个返回结果里。然后是三项各自独立的检查，输出都解析成结构化结果：`tsc --noEmit` 解析成文件、行号和报错信息；`prettier --check` 解析成有问题的文件列表；`bun test` 解析成计数和失败测试的名字。

note.en: More than one match and no replace_all: refused, with a hint she can act on.
note.zh: 匹配到不止一处、又没说 replace_all：直接拒绝，并告诉她怎么改。

note.en: A run comes back as counts plus the failing tests' names, and it passes only on exit 0 with zero failures.
note.zh: 跑完交回来的是计数加失败测试的名字；退出码为 0、失败数为 0，才算通过。

text.en: I can edit almost anything on this machine and run commands too; off-limits are your secrets, the code that grades me, and the obviously destructive stuff.
text.zh: 这台机器上的东西我基本都能改，命令也能跑；动不了的是你的密钥、给我打分的代码，还有明摆着会搞坏东西的操作。

text.en: That matches the code. She works across his whole machine, not inside one project folder: the workspace root is only where relative paths start. So the walls are a blocklist, and every file tool sends its path through one gate, `resolveInWorkspace`. **Secrets** (`.env` files, `*.pem` and `*.key`, `id_rsa*`, `~/.ssh`, `~/.aws`, `~/.gnupg`, cloud and Docker credentials, keychains, browser profiles) are refused for read, write and execute. The **evaluator firewall** makes read-only every `*.test.ts`, the TypeScript, prettier and lint configs, and the code that judges, sandboxes or gates her: this gate itself, the shell deny-list and executor, the parser behind `run_tests`, the safety gate for wakings, the SSRF guard, her thinking contract and the message-length caps. The code calls it the DGM safeguard, after the Darwin Gödel Machine, a self-improving coding agent: she must never be able to write the code that judges her. Here that is concrete: `recall.test.ts` was read-only to her, so the only road from red to green ran through `recall.ts`.
text.zh: 这话和代码对得上。她是在他整台机器上干活，不是被关在某个项目目录里：工作区根目录只是相对路径的起点。所以边界是一张黑名单：每个文件工具都要把路径送进同一道关卡 `resolveInWorkspace`。**密钥和凭证**（`.env` 文件、`*.pem` 和 `*.key`、`id_rsa*`、`~/.ssh`、`~/.aws`、`~/.gnupg`、云服务和 Docker 的凭证、钥匙串、浏览器 profile 目录）读、写、执行一律拒绝。**评估器防火墙**（evaluator firewall）让一批文件对她只读：所有 `*.test.ts`，TypeScript、prettier 和 lint 的配置，再加上评判、隔离、约束她的那些代码，包括这道关卡本身、命令黑名单和执行器、`run_tests` 背后判定过没过的解析器、主动唤醒的安全闸门、SSRF 防护、她的思维契约，还有消息长度上限。代码里管这叫 DGM safeguard（DGM 即 Darwin Gödel Machine，一个会自我改进的编程智能体）：她永远不能改写评判她的代码。放到这一幕就很具体：`recall.test.ts` 对她只读，从红到绿只有一条路，改 `recall.ts`。

note.en: Reads pass. Writes, and runs aimed at these files, stop here. Any name ending in .test.ts matches.
note.zh: 读放行；写，或者点名运行这些文件，都会在这里拦下。文件名以 .test.ts 结尾的都算。

text.en: The gate resolves before it judges. It follows `realpath` first, so a symlink into `~/.ssh` is judged by where it really points. On macOS and Windows, where file names ignore case, it compares case-folded, so `.ENV` or `Recall.Test.ts` is caught too. Shell adds layers of its own: the deny-list refuses destructive commands first (scene 4), then every path-looking word in the command goes through the same gate, and so does the working directory. Each word first meets a tail check, which catches `$HOME/.aws/credentials` even when a variable hides the real prefix.
text.zh: 这道关卡先解析、再判定。它先走 realpath，所以指向 `~/.ssh` 的符号链接，按它真正指向的位置来判。在 macOS 和 Windows 这类文件名不分大小写的系统上，比较前先统一大小写，`.ENV`、`Recall.Test.ts` 一样拦得住。shell 还有自己的几层：命令黑名单先把破坏性命令挡掉（见第 4 幕）；接着，命令里每个看着像路径的词都要过同一道关卡，工作目录也一样。每个词过关卡之前，还要先过一道尾部检查：哪怕真实前缀藏在变量里，`$HOME/.aws/credentials` 也照样拦下。

note.en: Every path-looking word in a command meets the same gate, after a tail check that sees through `$HOME`.
note.zh: 命令里每个像路径的词都要过同一道关卡；在那之前，先做一道能看穿 `$HOME` 的尾部检查。

text.en: The CI he mentions is the repo's real workflow: on every push to main and every pull request, `ci.yml` type-checks the protocol, server, web and desktop packages, builds the front end and the showcase, then runs the whole suite, on Ubuntu and on Windows. A green run holds classes of promise in place, not just features: the walls of sheet 6, case by case (secret files and folders, a symlink into `~/.ssh`, case variants, a secret path hidden behind `$HOME` in a shell command, the firewall's files, and an edit to a test file refused through the real dispatcher); the shell's deny patterns; a system prompt that stays byte-identical from turn to turn (scene 1); soft-deleted facts that never come back in recall; the wire contract, with the replay's tapes parsed against it; and these notes, checked against the source (scene 14). And now the tie, pinned by the regression test from sheet 4.
text.zh: 他提到的 CI 就是仓库里真实的工作流：每次推送到 main、每个 pull request，`ci.yml` 都会给 protocol、server、web、desktop 四个包做类型检查，构建前端和展示页，再跑全量测试，Ubuntu 和 Windows 各跑一遍。一次全绿钉住的不只是功能，而是一类一类的承诺：第 6 页那些边界，一条条都有测试（密钥文件和目录、指向 `~/.ssh` 的符号链接、大小写变体、shell 命令里借 `$HOME` 藏起来的密钥路径、防火墙里的文件，还有一次改测试文件的 edit，走真正的调度器，照样被拒）；shell 的黑名单规则；每一轮都逐字节不变的 system prompt（见第 1 幕）；软删除的事实，召回时再也不会冒出来；前后端之间的通信协议，回放磁带要按它校验；还有你正在读的这些笔记，也要对着源码核对（见第 14 幕）。现在又多了这个 tie：第 4 页的回归测试把它钉住了。

note.en: Marked as read, so only the firewall can refuse it — and the file is never written.
note.zh: 先标成已读，能拦它的就只剩防火墙；文件一个字节都没被写。

text.en: Commit it while you're at it?
text.zh: 顺手 commit 了呗？

text.en: I could. But the commit log should have your name on it — look at the diff, and you press enter.
text.zh: 能是能。但 commit 记录上得是你的名字。diff 你过一眼，回车你来按。

text.en: Nothing in the code stops her. The deny-list has no rule for git, and her prompt names git among the things shell is for, so “I could” is true. What she follows is her own procedure: the last step of flaky-test-triage, the skill she fetched at the start, ends “The commit is his.” The walls are code and cover what must never happen; this one is her call, so she hands him the diff and the enter key.
text.zh: 代码里没有任何东西拦着她。命令黑名单里没有关于 git 的规则，她的 prompt 还把 git 列为 shell 的用途之一，所以“能是能”是实话。她照着走的是自己那套流程：开场取回的 flaky-test-triage，最后一步以“commit 留给他”收尾。边界是代码，只管绝不能发生的事；这一步是她自己拿主意：diff 交给他看，回车留给他按。

note.en: Git is on the list of what her prompt says shell is for.
note.zh: 她的 prompt 里写明，git 正是 shell 的用途之一。

hook.en: Why did she come back with one more thing, four seconds later, without being asked?
hook.zh: 没人问，她怎么隔了四秒又自己补了一句？

title.en: One more thing, four seconds later

text.en: One more thing, and then I'll drop it
text.zh: 再说一句，说完就不提了。

text.en: When her reply to his message finishes, the server flips a weighted coin, which lands heads 35% of the time by default. The coin is code. Her reply carries no "I have more to say" flag for the model to set. On heads, a timer waits `LUNA_SELFCONT_PAUSE_MS`, 4000 ms by default, then wakes her once with one instruction: add a genuinely new thought, or do nothing. Only a turn he started gets a roll. There is none after her own wakings, and none when that reply asked to dream.
text.zh: 她每回完他一条消息，服务器就掷一次硬币，而且是一枚两面概率不一样的硬币：默认 35% 的概率掷出正面。掷硬币的是代码；她的回复里没有“我还有话说”这类能由模型置位的标记。掷出正面，就起一个定时器，等 `LUNA_SELFCONT_PAUSE_MS`（默认 4000 毫秒），再把她叫醒一次，只给一条指令：真有新的想法就补一句，没有就什么都别做。只有他发起的回合才掷：她自己被唤醒的回合不掷；这一轮要是她提出了入梦，也不掷。

note.en: Turning off the proactive switch, or setting `LUNA_SELFCONT=0`, stops continuations. Tests pin both ends of the coin: at probability 1 it always lands heads, at 0 never.
note.zh: 关掉主动开关，或者设 `LUNA_SELFCONT=0`，就不会追加。测试把硬币的两头都钉住了：概率为 1 必定掷出正面，为 0 永远掷不出正面。

text.en: The rest is checked when the timer fires, not when the coin lands. First: is anyone still connected? A second thought nobody will see isn't worth a model call. Then: is the session free, with no reply running, no other waking and no dream? If either answer is no, the continuation is dropped, not postponed. By design it stays outside the budget and cooldowns her other wakings share (scene 7). It is already bounded: at most one per message he sends, and a continuation never schedules another.
text.zh: 其余的检查放在定时器响的那一刻，而不是掷硬币的时候。先看还有没有人连着：没人看得到的追加，不值得花一次模型调用。再看会话是不是空闲：没有回复在跑、没有别的唤醒、也没在做梦。有一条不满足，这次追加就直接作废，不会顺延。设计上，它不占她其他几种唤醒共用的额度和冷却（第 7 幕）：它本身就有上限，他每发一条消息最多追加一次，追加回合自己也不会再排下一次。

text.en: Replay: this waking is scripted, so it always fires here. In the live app the chance is 35% per reply, and most replies get no second thought.
text.zh: 回放里，这次唤醒是写死在脚本里的，所以每次播到这里都会触发。真实应用里，每条回复只有 35% 的概率触发，大多数回复后面不会再跟一句“转念一想”。

text.en: You've said that in February, April and now.
text.zh: 这话你二月说过，四月说过，现在又说了一遍。

text.en: Before the model sees his message, the server searches her memory with his words: past turns, facts, diaries and skills (ranking in scene 8). Up to 18 hits go into a `<memory>` block, oldest first, which introduces them as handed to her, not recalled fresh. Code dates each hit: a turn by when it happened, a fact or diary by when it was written. Within a week the label is relative ("yesterday", "3 days ago"). Past that it becomes a calendar date, hence "February, April". Stored text is flattened to one line and clipped, and any literal `<memory>` tag inside it is defused, so nothing she remembers can close the block early. With embeddings on, up to three close matches in meaning are guaranteed a slot, however old they are.
text.zh: 模型看到他的消息之前，服务器先拿他的原话去搜她的记忆（对话回合、事实、日记、技能；怎么排序见第 8 幕）。最多 18 条结果放进一个 `<memory>` 块，从旧到新排，开头先交代清楚：这些是递给她的，不是她自己刚想起来的。每条前面的时间标签都由代码算好：对话回合用发生的时间，事实和日记用写下的时间。一周以内写成相对时间（“yesterday”“3 days ago”），超过一周就直接写成具体日期，所以才有“二月、四月”。存下的文字会被压成一行、截断；文字里要是出现字面的 `<memory>` 标签，尖括号会被剥掉，所以记忆里的任何一句都没法提前把这个块关上。开启 embedding（向量检索）后，语义足够接近的至多 3 条有保底名额，再旧也不会被挤掉。

note.en: Code computes each time label, and the block tells her to trust the timing, not recompute it. The trust covers the timing only. If a memory's content is wrong, she can still correct it.
note.zh: 每个时间标签都由代码算好，块里明确告诉她：时间直接信，别自己推算。信的只是时间；记忆里说的内容要是有错，她照样可以纠正。

title.en: The note she wakes up to
title.zh: 她醒来看到的那张纸条

text.en: The continuation runs on the normal turn engine, like every waking (scene 4), with the stage direction below in place of his message. Silence is a valid ending: the guard that makes a reply speak is off for proactive turns. The memory search is skipped, since a stage direction is not a question to search with. But her window still holds the turn that just ended, `<memory>` block included. Fresh time and weather blocks ride along again, and the time block's gap line reads "just now (still in the same conversation)". So his own words, "I think" included, are right in front of her. What she made of them was the model's own reading.
text.zh: 这次追加和其他唤醒一样，走的是普通的回合引擎（第 4 幕），只是原本放他消息的位置，换成了下面这段舞台指示。什么都不说也是允许的：要求回复必须开口的那道守卫，在主动回合里不生效。这一轮不做记忆检索，因为舞台指示不是一个能拿去搜的问题。但她的上下文里还留着刚结束的那个回合，连同那个 `<memory>` 块；时间块和天气块也照常重新附上一份最新的，时间块里“距上一条消息”那一行写的是 just now (still in the same conversation)，也就是还在同一段对话里。所以，他那句原话，连同里面的“我想”，都摆在她眼前。从里面看出什么，是模型自己的判断。

text.en: People who've decided don't say 'I think'.
text.zh: 真想好了的人，不会加“我想”。

blocks.snippet:
continuation:
    '(You just finished replying. Like a real person who paused and then thought of one more thing: ' +
    'if you have a SINGLE genuinely new thought to add — not a rephrase, not a summary, not "anyway" ' +
    'filler — say it now in one short message. If you have nothing truly new to add, do nothing.)',

note.en: That is the whole instruction: one genuinely new thought in one short message, or nothing.
note.zh: 整条指令就这些：要么一句真正新的话，要么什么都不做。

title.en: Why she didn't talk over herself

text.en: Her second line can still be playing aloud when the continuation starts. A turn he started opens with `turn.started`, and the app treats that as a barge-in: `audio.stop()` cuts the line in progress and drops everything queued behind it. A waking never sends that event. It announces itself with `proactive.started`, which sets the thinking pose and the chip and leaves the audio alone. Her new line joins the voice queue and waits for the last one to end. Each side has a test: a proactive turn emits no `turn.started`, and `turn.started` stops the voice.
text.zh: 追加回合开始时，她的第二句可能还在播。他发起的回合以 `turn.started` 开场，前端把它当成打断：`audio.stop()` 掐掉正在播的那句，排在后面的也全部丢掉。唤醒从不发这个事件，改发 `proactive.started`：切换到思考姿势、亮出状态标签（chip），但不碰音频。于是新的一句进入语音队列，等上一句播完才开始。两边各有测试钉住：主动回合不发 `turn.started`；`turn.started` 一到，语音就停。

note.en: Only a turn he started emits `turn.started`. A waking runs through this same engine and skips it.
note.zh: 只有他发起的回合才发 `turn.started`。唤醒走的是同一个引擎，唯独跳过这一句。

note.en: Each line chains onto the tail of the one before, so playback is strictly one line at a time while synthesis runs ahead. Only `clear()` drops what is waiting; the barge-in's `audio.stop()` calls it.
note.zh: 每一句都挂在前一句的尾巴后面，所以一次只播一句，合成可以提前跑。只有 `clear()` 会丢掉还在排队的句子；打断时的 `audio.stop()` 调的就是它。

text.en: The chip's glyph comes from the cycle id. A continuation's id contains `:cont:` and gets the thought bubble. Every other waking gets the sprout.
text.zh: 标签上显示哪个图标，看 cycle id：追加回合的 id 里带 `:cont:`，显示思考气泡；其他唤醒一律显示小芽。

title.zh: 同一时刻，只跑一个回合

text.en: His message, a continuation, a heartbeat waking and a dream all want the same session, and the server keeps them from overlapping. A session runs one turn at a time. `activeTurn` is set before the turn's first await and cleared in `finally`. A message that arrives while it is set is answered with `turn_in_progress` instead of starting a second turn on a history the first is still writing. Every waking also passes through one lock, shown below.
text.zh: 他的消息、追加、心跳唤醒、做梦，抢的都是同一个会话，服务器不让它们重叠。一个会话同一时刻只跑一个回合：`activeTurn` 在回合的第一个 await 之前就置上，在 `finally` 里清掉；这期间来的消息，直接回一个 `turn_in_progress`，不会在前一个回合还没写完的历史上再开一个回合。所有唤醒还都要过同一把锁，见下面。

note.en: No await separates the checks from the claim, so two callers racing for one session can't both get through. Tests pin this: a second acquire while the first is in flight returns null, and two concurrent calls never fire twice.
note.zh: 检查和占位之间没有任何 await，所以两个同时抢同一个会话的调用，不可能都过去。测试钉住了这一点：前一个还没结束时再来抢，拿到的是 null；两个并发调用，绝不会触发两次。

text.en: If the last client disconnects mid-reply, the server aborts the upstream model call instead of letting it stream to nobody. A browser refresh opens its new socket before closing the old one, so a refresh doesn't trigger it.
text.zh: 回复到一半，最后一个客户端断开了，服务器就中止上游的模型调用，不让它对着空气把话说完。浏览器刷新会先连上新的 socket 再关旧的，所以刷新不算断开。

title.en: Inside a turn: which tools may overlap
title.zh: 回合之内：哪些工具可以同时跑

text.en: Within a turn, each tool declares a concurrency policy, and the dispatcher enforces it. Pure reads such as `recall`, `read_file` and `web_search` are `safe-parallel` and run at once. Anything that speaks or writes, such as `message`, `remember`, `edit` and `shell`, is `session-serial` and waits its turn on the session's mutex. So two messages in one round are delivered in the order she wrote them. `global-serial` covers state the whole machine shares. Its one member is `music_control`, because two commands sent at the same moment would interleave on one player.
text.zh: 在一个回合里，每个工具都声明自己的并发策略，由调度器执行。纯读取的工具，比如 `recall`、`read_file`、`web_search`，是 `safe-parallel`，可以同时跑。凡是会说话或会写东西的，比如 `message`、`remember`、`edit`、`shell`，都是 `session-serial`，排在这个会话的互斥锁后面。所以同一轮里的两条消息，送达的顺序就是她写下的顺序。`global-serial` 管的是整台机器共享的状态，只有 `music_control` 一个：两条控制命令要是同时发，会在同一个播放器上交错。

note.en: Each parallel call gets its own stream. Each serial group becomes one stream that waits on its mutex, and the dispatcher merges the streams. Tests measure this: three parallel calls really overlap, and serial calls never run two at once.
note.zh: 每个并行调用各占一条流，每组串行调用合成一条流、排在各自的锁后面，最后由调度器合并。测试实测过：三个并行调用真的同时在跑；串行调用从来不会两个一起跑。

hook.en: He said he didn't want to talk about it. Why didn't she ask what happened, and what did she have to go on instead?
hook.zh: 他说了不想聊。她为什么真就一句“怎么了”都没问？不问的话，她又是靠什么接下去的？

text.en: Then don't. No questions from me tonight.
text.zh: 那就不说。今晚我一个问题都不问。

text.en: Nothing on the server labels his mood. Her system prompt carries standing rules instead. The seed of her soul says "When the user is cautious, don't push too hard" and rules out scripted comfort. The rules for how she speaks go further: a reply can simply end, she asks something back only when she is genuinely curious, and hollow check-ins tacked onto the end are banned as closers, "What's wrong?" among them by name. So she is free to answer with no question at all. The promise itself is the model's choice: the rules are code, the sentence is not.
text.zh: 服务端没有任何地方给他的情绪打标签，有的只是她 system prompt 里几条常驻的规则。她灵魂文件（soul）的初始版本写着 “When the user is cautious, don't push too hard”（对方谨慎时，别逼得太紧），也写明不说套话式的安慰。规定她怎么说话的那段规则更进一步：回复可以说完就停；只有真的好奇才反问；在结尾硬塞一句空洞的例行关心也不行，“What's wrong?”（怎么了？）就被点名列在禁用的收尾句里。所以她完全可以只回话、不提问。至于“一个问题都不问”这个承诺，是模型自己的选择：规则是代码给的，这句话是模型写的。

blocks.snippet:
'A reply can simply end — you do not owe every message a trailing question, and you ask ' +
    'something back only when you are genuinely, specifically curious, never as reflexive ' +
    'engagement bait. So never tack a hollow check-in onto the end: banned closers, and anything ' +
    'with their flavor — "Still here", "What\'s on your mind?", "Let me know", "I\'m here whenever", ' +
    '"Talk to me", "What\'s wrong?", "在吗", "还在吗". When the user sends something light or empty ' +
    '(an "OwO", a "lol", a keysmash), answer just as lightly; never inflate a thin message into a ' +
    'probing or status question.'

note.en: Part of every system prompt: permission to stop first, then the banned closers by name.
note.zh: 每份 system prompt 都带着这段：先允许说完就停，再点名列出禁用的收尾句。

title.en: Her face waits for her voice

text.en: You don't have to explain it for it to count. It counted.
text.zh: 你不用解释。今天烂就是烂，用不着理由。

text.en: Her messages can arrive faster than she can say them, and her voice plays one line at a time. So the next message often lands while the current line is still being spoken. That is why a line's face follows its voice, not its message: the expression is set in the callback that fires when the line starts to sound. A line that never sounds (its synthesis failed) gets its face when its turn in the voice queue comes, and a `faced` latch makes sure no line's face is set twice. Here the first line carries `steady_presence`, which plays no clip, so she stays at rest while she says it; the tender clip starts when the second line starts to sound. Scene 1 covers which expression plays which clip.
text.zh: 她的消息可能来得比她说得快，而语音一次只播一句，所以下一条消息常常在上一句还没说完时就到了。因此，每句的表情跟着这句自己的语音走，而不是跟着消息到达的时刻：表情在语音的开始回调里设置，也就是这句真正出声的那一刻；要是这句根本没出声（比如合成失败），就等语音队列轮到它时再换；`faced` 这个标记保证同一句的表情不会设两次。这里第一句从头到尾都是静息表情（`steady_presence` 不播 clip），温柔的那段 clip 到第二句开口时才开始。哪种表情播哪段 clip，见第 1 幕。

note.en: `face()` runs from the voice's start callback, and again when the line's promise settles, so a line that never started still gets its face; for a line that did start, `faced` makes the second call a no-op.
note.zh: `face()` 在语音的开始回调里调用一次，这句的 promise 结束时再调一次，这样没出声的句子也能换上表情；如果这句已经开口，`faced` 会让第二次调用直接返回。

title.zh: 两句话之间，还留着什么？

text.en: Under the clips runs a slower mood: three numbers for valence (pleasant or not), arousal (calm or keyed up) and dominance (leading or yielding). Each line's affect, applied when its voice starts, pulls a target point toward that affect's coordinates. The number she attaches (0.3 to 0.6 here) sets how far it pulls and how long it holds: at least 6 s, then a drift back toward neutral with a half-life of about 38 s. On screen, the mood shifts the pose she relaxes to and adds a faint undertone beneath any clip. So consecutive tender lines build on each other, and after "Okay." the warmth fades slowly instead of snapping off. The two-timescale design, a fast current value chasing a slowly decaying target, is adapted from the open-source soullink-emotion-sdk and re-derived for her 15 affects without taking the dependency; the chase is frame-rate independent, and each step is capped, so a tab left in the background never makes her mood jump.
text.zh: clip 底下还跑着一层变化更慢的心情，用三个数表示：愉悦度 valence（舒服与否）、唤醒度 arousal（平静还是激动）、支配度 dominance（主导还是退让）。每句话的 affect 在这句语音开始时生效，把一个目标点往这个 affect 对应的坐标拉。她附上的那个数（这一幕在 0.3 到 0.6 之间）决定拉多远、维持多久：至少 6 秒，之后以约 38 秒的半衰期向中性回落。落到画面上，心情会改变她放松下来时回到的姿态，还会在任何 clip 底下垫一层淡淡的底色。所以连着几句温柔的话会一层层叠上去；说完“好。”之后，那份暖意是慢慢退去的，不会一下子断掉。这套“快变的当前值追着慢慢衰减的目标值”的双时间尺度设计，借鉴自开源的 soullink-emotion-sdk，按她自己的 15 种 affect 重新推导，没有引入这个依赖；追赶过程与帧率无关，每一步的步长也有上限，标签页在后台挂久了再切回来，心情不会突然跳变。

note.en: The pull grows with her number (0.28 + 0.58 × it), and so does the hold above the 6 s floor.
note.zh: 拉力随她给的数 i 增大（0.28 + 0.58 × i）；6 秒下限之上多出来的维持时间，也随 i 变长。

text.en: Her body keeps moving on its own, too. An idle gesture fires at a random interval of 8 to 20 seconds, but only while no expression clip is playing and she is neither speaking nor asleep. Which of the nine it is comes from a weighted random draw: each weight is 1 plus the gesture's three coefficients, each multiplied by the matching mood axis, never below 0.05, and her last three picks sit out. Mood tilts the odds; it never picks a gesture or rules one out. The lean-in and the tender sway in this scene are two of those nine. On the tape they are scripted cues (scene 14), and like the live scheduler, each waits until her line has ended.
text.zh: 她的身体也会自己动。每隔 8 到 20 秒不等，会触发一个待机小动作，前提是没有表情 clip 在播，她既没在说话也没睡着。九个动作里抽哪个是加权随机：每个动作的权重是 1，再加上它的三个系数与当前心情三个轴逐项相乘之和，但不低于 0.05；最近做过的 3 个，这次不参与抽签。心情只把概率往一边偏，从不直接替她选，也不会把哪个动作彻底排除。这一幕里的前倾和温柔的慢摇，就是这九个里的两个。回放里它们是剧本排好的动作（见第 14 幕），和真实的调度器一样，都等她这句话说完才做。

note.en: Recent picks sit out first; each weight is 1 plus coefficient × mood on every axis, floored at 0.05.
note.zh: 先把最近抽过的排除；每个动作的权重是 1 加上各轴的“系数 × 心情”，下限 0.05。

text.en: He did. She can press play too: `music_control` plays, pauses and skips on the player he has open, though it has no way to pick a song. The tool deliberately carries no risk mark, so in a conversation she starts herself, she must say what she is about to do before she touches his playback (scene 4). What she gets without asking is what's playing. Music is opt-in (`LUNA_MUSIC=1`) and macOS only. A resident `media-control` process hears each track change, the server keeps it in memory, and each turn a formatter adds a line to his message, no tool call. So "Music's on." arrives carrying: Music the user is playing right now: "ball w/o you" by 21 Savage (album "i am > i was") — it just started. He knows this one well: 212 plays, about 52 hours of listening — his #1 most-played overall.
text.zh: 是他按的。不过她也有播放键：`music_control` 能对他开着的播放器播放、暂停、切歌，只是没法点歌。这个工具故意没有标记风险等级，所以在她主动开口的回合里，要动他的播放，得先把要做什么说出来（见第 4 幕）。她不用问就能拿到的，是正在放什么。音乐功能要手动开启（`LUNA_MUSIC=1`），而且只支持 macOS。每次切歌，常驻的 `media-control` 进程都会收到通知，服务端把当前曲目存在内存里；每个回合，一个格式化函数往他的消息里加一行，不经过任何工具调用。所以“放了点歌。”送到模型时，带着这样一行：Music the user is playing right now: "ball w/o you" by 21 Savage (album "i am > i was") — it just started. He knows this one well: 212 plays, about 52 hours of listening — his #1 most-played overall.（大意：他正在放这首歌，刚开始；这首他很熟，播过 212 次，累计约 52 小时，是他听得最多的一首。）

note.en: Read from memory on every turn: the track line, plus how well he knows it when the song matched his library.
note.zh: 每个回合都从内存里读：先是曲目那一行；这首歌若对上了他的曲库，再补一句他有多熟。

text.en: Replay: no song plays on this page. The player card is the real one, reading a scripted record shelf.
text.zh: 回放说明：这个页面不会放出任何歌曲。播放器卡片是真实组件，读的是剧本里排好的曲库。

title.en: Why look up what she already knew?
title.zh: 已经知道的事，为什么还要查？

text.en: You told me once it's your favourite
text.zh: 你跟我说过，这是你最喜欢的一首。

text.en: The song was already in his message, and the fact that it's his favourite may already have been on her page: saved facts are listed in her system prompt every turn, up to a cap per category (scene 5). But that list is kept plain, each fact's text and id and no date, because it sits in the cached part of the prompt, where the code allows no timestamps (scene 6 covers the cache). `recall` searches her memory by meaning, across saved facts, past conversation and diaries, and every hit comes back with its text, its source and `when_ms`, when that memory was made. The card shows only the count. In this story the one hit is the fact she saved on 8 September, when he mentioned the song in passing; "You told me once" stands on it. Scene 8 covers how hits are ranked.
text.zh: 歌名已经在他的消息里了，“这是他最喜欢的歌”这条事实，也可能本来就摆在她眼前：存下的事实每个回合都会列进她的 system prompt，每类有上限（第 5 幕）。但那份清单刻意写得很素，每条只有正文和 id，没有日期，因为它在 prompt 的缓存部分里，代码不允许往那里写时间戳（缓存见第 6 幕）。`recall` 按语义检索她自己的记忆，范围包括存下的事实、过去的对话和日记；每条命中都带着原文、来源和 `when_ms`，也就是这段记忆形成的时间。卡片上只显示条数。在这个故事里，唯一那条命中是她 9 月 8 日存下的事实：那天他随口提过自己最喜欢的歌。“你跟我说过”，底气就在这儿。命中怎么排序，见第 8 幕。

note.en: What a hit hands back: the text, where it came from, and when.
note.zh: 一条命中交回来的东西：原文、出处，还有时间。
